| 5111100 | Attire of Sir Ansbach. Black cloth adorned with gold embroidery.\n\nSlightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills. | 老兵安帕赫的上衣。\n在黑色上衣缀以金色刺绣的防具。\n\n能些微强化血盟的战技与王朝的招式。 |
| 5120000 | Golden helm of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.\n\nA hideous scarlet wound was once hewn into the center of her face.\n\nLater, Miquella gently put his lips to it and the unfading scar became the compass that Freyja would thereafter follow. | 拉塔恩将军的禁卫骑士──\n“红狮子”弗蕾亚的黄金头盔。\n\n颜面部位有一道丑陋的猩红伤痕。\n\n在过去，米凯拉吻上那道伤痕──\n从那之后，伤痕就成了不会消失的引导。 |

| 5130000 | Steel helm of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol.\nPart of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.\n\nThe nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts. | 孤牢骑士团的钢制头盔。\n以钢片连接，保护全身的重装盔甲；\n此为构成该盔甲的一部分。\n\n据说那些失去名字，或是失去心的战士灵魂，\n会栖身在幽影之地的无名灵庙之中。 |

| 5180000 | Pointed helm of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.\n\nSlightly increases maximum HP, stamina, and maximum equip load.\n\nEach and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master. | 直属“穿刺者”梅瑟莫的\n火焰骑士们穿戴的尖头头盔。\n\n能些微提升血量、精力，以及装备重量的上限。\n\n据说他们是黄金树的贵族，\n对梅瑟莫宣示忠诚之后，\n因此受到疏远，被逐出故乡。 |

| 5182000 | Helm of Wego, elder among the Fire Knights. Two warped death masks stacked one atop the other.\n\nReduces FP used to summon spirits.\n\nGnawed at by loneliness, the old man turned his attention to the spirituality of Messmer's flame, using it in a rite of resurrection.\n\nYet the soulless bodies he brought to life were no comfort to poor Wego. | 火焰骑士之中的老者，温戈的头盔。\n由两副表情松弛的死亡面具，上下堆迭而成。\n\n能减少召唤灵魂时消耗的专注值。\n\n温戈饱受孤独折磨──\n当他注意到梅瑟莫之火的灵性力量后，\n便企图用于复活。\n\n然而无魂的活尸，无法疗愈他的心。 |
| 5183000 | Helm of Kood, captain of the Fire Knights. A winged serpent perches atop it.\n\nEnhances Fire Knight skills.\n\nThe winged serpent is the token creature of Messmer's military forces. | 5184000 | Hood of Salza, sage of the Fire Knights.\n\nA prodigious amount of cloth wound around it, giving the impression of a greatly swollen head, and wearing it increases intelligence.\n\nA disciple of the elder Wego, he refused to burn down an old ruin, at the risk of his own life. | 火焰骑士之中的贤者，萨赞的风帽。\n\n将剩余的布大幅度地缠绕，\n最后形成的模样，犹如巨大的后脑勺。\n能提升智力。\n\n萨赞是老者温戈的徒弟。\n据说他冒着生命危险，\n向温戈进谏不要放火焚烧古遗迹。 |
| 5190000 | Headband worn by highland warriors, made of woven leather. The white favor represents their home settlement.\n\nHighland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast. | 高地战士们穿戴的头带。\n以皮绳细腻编织，缠绕配戴的防具。\n垂放的白布为代表故乡的记号。\n\n高地战士是熊的猎人。\n挺身挑战强大野兽，象征着他们的荣誉。 |
| 5190100 | Traditional garb of highland warriors, made from woven fabric and finished with fur. This garment is made from fabrics with both blue and red patterns.\n\nRed-patterned fabrics were allowed only to those who hunted bears—the greatest and most glorious of the highlanders. | 高地战士们穿戴的传统服装。\n在搭配布料制成的铠甲上披毛皮，\n再以红蓝各一条的花纹布装饰的防具。\n\n据说在熊的猎人之中，表现特别出色的人，\n会赠予红色花纹布以表荣誉。 |
| 5190200 | Arm wraps worn by highland warriors, made of sturdy leather and fastened with winding straps.\n\nHighland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast. | 高地战士们穿戴的腕套。\n用坚固皮革缠绕配戴的防具。\n\n高地战士是熊的猎人。\n挺身挑战强大野兽，象征着他们的荣誉。 |

| 5191000 | Helm worn by highland warriors, pieced together using leather. | 5191100 | Traditional garb of highland warriors, made from woven fabric and finished with a blue patterned cloth.\n\nHighland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast. | 高地战士们穿戴的传统服装。\n在搭配布料制成的铠甲上，\n以蓝色花纹布装饰的防具。\n\n高地战士是熊的猎人。\n挺身挑战强大野兽，象征着他们的荣誉。 |
| 5200000 | Golden helm of the Death Knights, whose own death masks served as the visards of their armor.\n\nEnhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.\n\nThe decayed golden wheel that adorns it represents their unbroken loyalty to Godwyn, he who became Prince of Death. | 死骑士的黄金头盔，\n并戴上自身死亡面具的防具。\n\n能强化王城古龙信仰的战技与祷告。\n\n葛德文变成死王子，\n但骑士们依然不改侍奉的主人──\n装饰在头盔后方的受侵蚀黄金环，就是宣言。 |
| 5200100 | Golden armor of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.\n\nEnhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.\n\nThese knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn. | 死骑士的黄金铠甲。\n缀以黄金树古老设计的防具。\n\n能强化王城古龙信仰的战技与祷告。\n\n死骑士曾是葛德文的禁卫骑士，\n他们寻找主人变化形貌后的分身尸骸，\n为即将到来的潜藏者当道的时代作准备。 |
| 5200200 | Golden gauntlets of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.\n\nEnhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.\n\nThese knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn. | 死骑士的黄金臂甲。\n缀以黄金树古老设计的防具。\n\n能强化王城古龙信仰的战技与祷告。\n\n死骑士曾是葛德文的禁卫骑士，\n他们寻找主人变化形貌后的分身尸骸，\n为即将到来的潜藏者当道的时代作准备。 |
| 5200300 | Golden greaves of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.\n\nEnhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.\n\nThese knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn. | 死骑士的黄金腿甲。\n缀以黄金树古老设计的防具。\n\n能强化王城古龙信仰的战技与祷告。\n\n死骑士曾是葛德文的禁卫骑士，\n他们寻找主人变化形貌后的分身尸骸，\n为即将到来的潜藏者当道的时代作准备。 |
| 5210000 | A mask affixed with a crown of tangled horns, worn by those who would invoke divinity.\n\nDivine invocation heightens the dexterity of the wearer, but causes the blessing of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.\n\nFocus is also troubled by wearing this mask. | 将蜿蜒混生角作为头冠的面具。\n神祇会降临在穿戴者身上。\n\n透过降神能提升灵巧，\n然而黄金树赐福排斥降神，\n会减少露滴圣杯瓶的恢复量。\n\n此外，也会降低理智度。 |
| 5210100 | Attire of the tower's ascetics, embodying their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.\n\nIn order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training. | 严以律己，坚持苦行──\n塔的修行者们穿戴的服装。\n\n他们为了成为肉身土地神，\n借由修行，提升自我的灵性力量。 |
| 5210200 | Wrist guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.\n\nIn order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training. | 严以律己，坚持苦行──\n塔的修行者们穿戴的手环。\n\n他们为了成为肉身土地神，\n借由修行，提升自我的灵性力量。 |
| 5210300 | Ankle guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.\n\nIn order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training. | 严以律己，坚持苦行──\n塔的修行者们穿戴的脚环。\n\n他们为了成为肉身土地神，\n借由修行，提升自我的灵性力量。 |
| 5220000 | Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents.\nSlightly enhances incantations of Messmer's flame as well as Fire Knight skills.\n\nThe winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions.\n\nThey were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form, born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he. | “穿刺者”梅瑟莫的黑色头盔。\n附有彼此交缠的两条带翼蛇。\n\n能些微强化梅瑟莫之火的祷告，\n以及火焰骑士的战技。\n\n在恶之蛇封印眼底，深感苦恼的时刻；\n在母亲的赐福崩毁之后，接受自身命运，\n化为恐怖模样的时刻──\n带翼蛇们都不离不弃，常伴梅瑟莫身旁。 |
| 5220100 | Black armor of Messmer the Impaler.\nDraped with a red cloak bearing his crest embroidered.\n\nOn his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired.\n\n"Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone." | “穿刺者”梅瑟莫的黑色铠甲。\n铠甲上披着缀以徽章刺绣的红色斗篷。\n\n为了完成母亲的心愿，那进行肃清的圣战，\n梅瑟莫自愿成为恐惧的象征。\n\n　要悲叹也行，诅咒也罢──\n　都向着我来吧。 |

| 5250200 | Gauntlets of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower, made from a thick metal. | 塔的守护者──角战士的臂甲。\n以一定厚度的金属制成的防具。 |

| 5252100 | Armor of feted horned warriors chosen to become divine beast warriors, adorned with a lion's pelt.\n\nAmong the divine beast warriors, only those who truly excel at divine invocation become sculpted keepers, and are granted the honor of the lion dance. | 受选的角战士──神兽战士的铠甲。\n铠甲上铺满狮子毛皮。\n\n据说在神兽战士中，只有降神能力卓越的人，\n才能成为勇人，获得舞动舞狮的荣誉。 |

| 5260000 | Ornate helm of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.\n\nRennala, head of the royal family of Caria, was said to have given her younger sister, who renounced her lineage to chase after Messmer, a gift of lustrous black hair. | “双月骑士”蕾菈娜的头盔。\n以银铁制成的细致防具。\n\n据说身为卡利亚王室领导者的蕾娜菈，\n在她的妹妹舍弃原生家庭，跟随梅瑟莫后，\n赠予妹妹富有光泽的黑色长发。 |
| 5260100 | Ornate armor of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.\n\nAdorned with the lapis-lazuli blue that is symbolic of Caria, its radiance is yet to fully fade. | “双月骑士”蕾菈娜的铠甲。\n以银铁制成的细致防具。\n\n铠甲上缀以蓝如青金石的装饰──\n那是卡利亚的象征色。\n看似黯淡，但仍保有色彩。 |
| 5260200 | Gloves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from quality leather. | “双月骑士”蕾菈娜的手套。\n以优质的皮革制成。 |

| 5270000 | The golden helm worn by Radahn in his younger years. | 5272000 | The circlet of light which adorned Miquella's head as he returned in divine aspect. It has begun to fade into nothingness.\n\nSlightly boosts intelligence, faith, and arcane, while also boosting the power of Miquella's light.\n\nThis circle was to be the very foundation upon which Miquella's age of compassion would be built, should it have ever come to pass. | 作为神祇归来的米凯拉穿戴的光芒头冠。\n头冠已经快要消失。\n\n能些微提升智力、信仰、感应，\n也能提升“米凯拉的光”的威力\n\n此为无缘实现的米凯拉的时代，\n在那温柔的法则下，诞生的初始之环。 |
| 5280000 | Helm as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.\n\nFreshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army? | 如幽影般黑暗的恶兵头盔。\n\n没有人会主动靠近、散发恶臭的战场遗迹，\n或是该被遗忘的禁域──\n\n如果说，这类地方是恶兵的归属，\n那么幽影之地，就是最适合他们的地方。 |
| 5280100 | Armor as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.\n\nFreshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army? | 如幽影般黑暗的恶兵铠甲。\n\n没有人会主动靠近、散发恶臭的战场遗迹，\n或是该被遗忘的禁域──\n\n如果说，这类地方是恶兵的归属，\n那么幽影之地，就是最适合他们的地方。 |

| 5280300 | Greaves as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.\n\nFreshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army? | 如幽影般黑暗的恶兵腿甲。\n\n没有人会主动靠近、散发恶臭的战场遗迹，\n或是该被遗忘的禁域──\n\n如果说，这类地方是恶兵的归属，\n那么幽影之地，就是最适合他们的地方。 |
| 5290000 | Ritual headwear in the form of a divine beast's head, used to perform the lion dance. Worn by the very finest of the sculpted keepers. Alas, it no longer responds to the old woman's earnest prayer.\n\nDivine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.\n\nFocus is also troubled by wearing this headwear. | 于舞狮时使用的神兽头部，\n最卓越的勇人穿戴的祭祀用具。\n只是现在，不会再回应老妪的祈祷。\n\n透过降神能提升风暴的威力，\n也能提升力气、灵巧，\n但会减少露滴圣杯瓶的恢复量。\n\n此外，也会降低理智度。 |
| 5300000 | St. Trina's life withered and fell, as fleeting as the seasons. At her last, she left a single water lily.\n\nSlightly boosts max FP.\n\nDespite the velvety-purple hue, the flower is in no way poisonous—it merely blooms in quietude. | 虚幻枯萎的托莉娜\n所留下的最后一朵睡莲。\n\n能些微提升专注值的上限。\n\n深紫色的睡莲不含任何毒素，\n只会温柔地绽放。 |
| 5310000 | Helm worn by Devonia, longest-serving of the Crucible Knights.\n\nHolds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.\n\nIt is said Devonia quested in search of the Crucible's origin, and departed from the lands of the Erdtree alone. | 据说是最资深的熔炉骑士──\n泥盆亚的头盔。\n\n蕴含初始黄金树──生命熔炉的力量，\n能强化熔炉百相的祷告。\n\n据说泥盆亚为了寻找熔炉的根，\n独自踏上旅程，离开黄金树。 |
| 5320000 | A greatjar which fits comfortably over the head when upturned. Attire of the shamans who perform their worship at gaols.\n\nIncreases the power of thrown pots of all sizes.\n\nThey offer their prayers to the innards of the greatjars, such that they might be reborn one day into sainthood. This is the cycle of death and rebirth, taken into the hands of mortal men. | 将壶倒盖、完整覆盖头部的大壶头罩。\n在监牢祈祷的祝祷师穿戴的防具。\n\n能提升投掷壶类、大壶类道具的威力。\n\n祝祷师为大壶的内容物祈祷──\n希望他们能重生为善良的好人。\n此为人为促成的轮回。 |
| 5330000 | Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.\n\nResembling a lion in appearance, life force faintly clings to it. | 将小恶魔魔像的头部，\n直接套在头上使用的头罩。\n\n外形神似狮子的头罩，蕴藏着些微的生命力。 |

| 1000 | The Tarnished will soon return. | 褪色者将要归来── |
| 1001 | Guided by Grace once lost. | 受那失去的赐福指引，回到此地。 |
| 1002 | The Golden Order is broken to its core. | 黄金律法早已破碎到无以复加。 |
| 1003 | They will fight. And they will die. In an unending curse. | 战斗、死亡──这永无止尽的诅咒， |
| 1004 | For how else is a champion, or a lord, to be born? | 却是催生英雄与王者的唯一温床。 |
| 1005 | Brandish the Elden Ring. | 为了我们所有人…… |
| 1006 | ...for all of us. | 展现艾尔登法环吧。 |

| 10000600 | Seek the Elden Ring! | 寻找艾尔登法环吧！ |

| 102001150 | "To become Elden Lord, and restore the Golden Order." | “成为艾尔登之王，修复黄金律法吧。” |
| 102001170 | Let the words of the Fingers guide you. | ……别忘了指头大人的话。 |
| 102002000 | Ahh, Great Runes are the stuff of demigods; | ……对了，大卢恩都是由半神持有。 |
| 102002010 | the children of the goddess, Queen Marika. She who is vessel of the Elden Ring. | 半神是指艾尔登法环的宿主──\n神祇女王玛莉卡，祂的孩子们。 |
| 102002020 | Tainted by the strength of their runes, her children warred, but none could become Elden Lord. | 那群孩子都因为大卢恩的力量堕入歧途，彼此争斗……\n但是没有人能当上艾尔登之王。 |

| 102002040 | Listen, the Fingers speak. | ……听吧，指头大人也说了： |
| 102002050 | "The Greater Will has long renounced the demigods." | “在许久许久以前，无上意志早已舍弃那群半神。” |
| 102002060 | "Tarnished, show no mercy. Have their heads. Take all they have left." | “褪色者啊，无须踌躇──尽情杀戮、掠夺他们吧。” |
| 102002070 | "The Fingers have willed it so." | “此为指头的引导。” |
| 102002080 | ...Indeed. But remember one thing. | ……话虽如此，你也要小心吶。 |
| 102002090 | The demigods are each and all the direct offspring of Queen Marika. | 半神全部都是玛莉卡女王的孩子， |
| 102002100 | Godrick the Grafted was but a distant relation... | 其中只有“接肢”葛瑞克是后代子孙…… |
| 102002110 | The runt of the litter, his divine blood sorely diluted. | 所以继承到的神祇血统最为稀薄，力量也最为弱小。 |
| 102003000 | Well, well… I see… | ……哦，还有啊…… |
| 102003010 | A remembrance of gold has found its way into your possession. | 你身上好像有黄金追忆吶。 |
| 102003020 | Demigods, and even the greater of the champions, | ……半神还有伟大的诸位英雄， |
| 102003030 | are hewn by the Erdtree upon their end, into remembrances. | 身形消失之后，会受黄金树雕琢，成为追忆。 |

| 102003050 | These remembrances yet house the power of their former masters. | 黄金追忆会保存追忆之主的力量， |
| 102003060 | And should you wish to wield that same power, well… | 如果你希望得到那力量，尽情施展…… |

| 102003080 | Heh… Do not recoil from my offer. | ……有什么好犹豫的吶？ |
| 102003090 | The Fingers guide us all. And you Tarnished, you are here to take, are you not? | 指头大人都出言引导了──要你们褪色者动手争夺。 |
| 102004000 | Ah. You have returned. What is it? | ……啊，是你啊。有什么事吶？ |
| 102005000 | Now, go forth. | ……好啦，快出发吧。 |

| 102010000 | I had my doubts, but...my, look at you. | ……哦，真不简单…… |
| 102010010 | Only once before have I seen two Great Runes together. | 从以前到现在，这是我第二次同时看到两片大卢恩吶。 |
| 102010020 | Look there. The Fingers shudder with exuberance. | 瞧啊，指头大人也十分激动： |
| 102010030 | "Fine work, brave Tarnished. The Greater Will is pleased." | “褪色者啊，做得很好。无上意志肯定会欢欣无比。” |

| 102010050 | "Now, seek the Erdtree, and an audience with Queen Marika." | “褪色者啊，朝着黄金树前进，觐见玛莉卡女王吧。” |
| 102010060 | "To become Elden Lord, and restore the Golden Order." | “成为艾尔登之王，修复黄金律法吧。” |
| 102010070 | The Fingers expect... | ……指头大人很期待你的表现吶。 |
| 102010080 | As much from you as they do young Gideon. | 嗯，大概跟基甸小鬼头不相上下。 |
| 102010090 | Take this. A token of farewell. | 收下吧，这是老太婆的一点心意。 |
| 102011000 | Now, go forth. | ……好啦，快出发吶。 |
| 102011010 | Become Elden Lord. | 你要当上艾尔登之王啊。 |

| 102012010 | A god, in truth. | 也就是说，祂是神吶。 |
| 102012020 | But after the Elden Ring's shattering, she was imprisoned in the Erdtree. | 然而祂在艾尔登法环破碎之后，被囚禁在黄金树之内── |
| 102012030 | A grim punishment for shattering the Order, despite her godhood. | 作为神却让律法破碎，那是犯下大错的惩罚。 |
| 102012040 | The Fingers speak... | ……指头大人说了： |
| 102012050 | "Marika's trespass demanded a heavy sentence." | “玛莉卡犯下的滔天大罪，处以重罚也不为过。” |
| 102012060 | "But even in shackles, she remains a god, and the vision's vessel." | “但即使祂受到重罚，仍旧是神，也是虚像的容器。” |
| 102012070 | "Confer Great Runes to become Elden Lord, and join Queen Marika as her consort." | “只要向那容器献上大卢恩，\n你就会成为她的伴侣──成为艾尔登之王。” |
| 102012080 | "The Fingers have willed it so." | “此为指头的引导。” |
| 102012090 | Now, you may go. | ……好啦，快出发吧。 |
| 102020000 | Well, you managed to return. | ……你回来啦。 |
| 102020010 | You know what this means. The Erdtree has spurned you. | 我很清楚吶，黄金树拒绝你了。 |
| 102020020 | The Fingers remain still. | ……指头大人也静止不动了── |
| 102020030 | Shaken by this turn of events, they are busy consulting the Greater Will. | 发生预料之外的事，感到困惑，正在与无上意志沟通。 |
| 102020040 | When they are finished, the Fingers will again offer their guidance. | 等到沟通结束，指头大人会再出言引导你们。 |
| 102020050 | But thousands, if not tens of thousands, of moons must first pass. | ……只是这可能要等上数千、数万个日子吶。 |

| 102020070 | My, oh, my... | ……好啦，会怎样发展…… |
| 102021000 | It may be thousands upon thousands of moons before the fingers again offer their guidance. | ……指头大人再出言引导，\n可能要等上数千、数万个日子吧。 |
| 102021010 | My, oh, my. Whatever will you do… | ……好啦，会怎样发展…… |
| 102030000 | Heavens forbid... | ……你这是…… |
| 102030010 | That is not the domain of mere men. | 那是身为人之子万万不得做出的事。 |
| 102030020 | The burning of the Erdtree is the first cardinal sin. And you say you seek the power of the Rune of Death, too? | 烧毁黄金树是最为原始的重罪，\n更别提追求死亡卢恩的力量…… |
| 102030030 | The Rune of Death goes by two names; the other is Destined Death. | 死亡卢恩就是“命定之死”── |
| 102030040 | The forbidden shadow, plucked from the Golden Order upon its creation… | 是黄金律法诞生之初，首先去除、封印的黑暗影子。 |
| 102030050 | Unleashing the rune now would be unthinkable... | 你却打算释放它…… |
| 102030060 | The Fingers would never permit it. Nor would the Greater Will. | ……这件事指头大人，不，无上意志绝对不会点头。 |
| 102030070 | ... | …… |
| 102030080 | ... | …… |
| 102030090 | But here we are... | ……然而…… |
| 102030100 | The Fingers, dormant, severing our link to the Greater Will. | ……现在指头大人静止不动，\n我们也无从感知无上意志。 |

| 102030120 | Who is to say that the cardinal sin must be cardinal forever? | 又怎能说，重罪如今仍是重罪？ |
| 102030130 | Go on. Finish the job. | ……你放手去做吧。 |

| 102031000 | You must find kindling. | ……去找火种吧。 |
| 102031010 | Only the smoldering flame in the Great Forge of the Giants, on the highest peak in the Lands Between, can burn the Erdtree. | 在交界地最高的地方，那里有个冒出袅袅轻烟的巨人大锅──\n能烧毁黄金树的火就在锅里。 |
| 102031020 | But special kindling is required to reignite the flame. | 然而想让锅里的火窜起，必须要有特殊的火种。 |
| 102031030 | For the flame to burn the Erdtree, a sacrifice is needed. Of one who envisions the flame. | ……要有能看见火焰虚像的人。\n唯有把那人当祭品，才能用大锅的火烧毁黄金树。 |
| 102031040 | And can lead you to the Rune of Death. | 前往死亡卢恩的路，也会随之明朗。 |
| 102040000 | You've done it, I see. | ……做得还真彻底啊。 |
| 102040010 | What use do you have for me, now? | 现在我们应该没有交集了？ |
| 102040020 | I am a Finger Reader. I will remain here, until their dialogue ends, and the Fingers speak again. | 我是“解指”，正在等待沟通结束，指头大人的发声。 |

| 102042000 | Don't worry, my dear. | ……也无妨吶。 |
| 102042010 | I'll see it to the end with you, if it please. | 只要你不嫌弃，\n我老太婆愿意陪你走到最后。 |
| 102043000 | Now, go forth. | ……好啦，快走吧。 |

| 102100010 | But don't raise your hopes; | 只是你误判了吶， |
| 102100020 | I have no secrets for you to plunder. | 我老太婆没有什么秘密。 |

| 102101000 | <sleeping> | …… |
| 106001000 | A pleasure to meet thee, Tarnished. | ……初次见面啊，褪色者。 |

| 106001020 | I'd heard tell of a Tarnished hurtling about atop a spectral steed. | 听说有褪色者骑着灵马， |
| 106001030 | And upon looking into the matter, | 让我花了点时间去找…… |
| 106001040 | the talk, I surmise, is of thee. | 看来就是你啊。 |

| 106002010 | I was entrusted this, for thee. | 有物品要转交给你。 |

| 106002040 | Summon them with it, from ash unreturned to the Erdtree. | 没有回归黄金树的骨灰，能从中召唤出灵魂。 |
| 106002050 | The spirits will obey thine command but briefly, as they recall battles past. | 而那些灵魂会暂时认你为主人，\n重现生前战斗的模样。 |
| 106002060 | Now it is thine. To do with as thou wishest. | ……哎，照你的意思使用吧。 |
| 106003000 | Forgive mine intrusion, Tarnished. | 褪色者啊，打扰你了。 |

| 106011000 | I will ask thee again. | ……我再问你一次。 |
| 106011010 | Thou'rt possessed of the power, no? | 那名为托雷特的灵马── |

| 106012000 | Quite the stubborn one, aren't we? | ……倒有趣了，想否定到底吗？ |

| 106012020 | Perhaps thine ample mistrust will be to thy benefit. | 不信任他人，反而是有益无害啊。 |

| 106012050 | ... | …… |
| 106020000 | What hopest thou to profit? | 你这是做什么？ |
| 106020010 | ... | …… |

| 106020050 | ... | …… |

| 106030030 | Each of us was chosen by our own Two Fingers, as a candidate to succeed Queen Marika, to become the new god of the coming age. | 我们各自被不同的双指找到，成为神祇候选人──\n预定继玛莉卡女王之后，成为下一个时代的神祇。 |

| 106101010 | I believe I said my name was Renna, when last we met. | 记得当时我自称蕾娜。 |
| 106101020 | It pleaseth me to see Torrent hale and hearty... | 很高兴看到托雷特过得不错。 |
| 106101030 | But Tarnished, what business hast thou here? | 那么，褪色者啊。你是为了什么而来？ |
| 106101040 | I have no memory of inking thee an invitation. | ……我应该没有发邀请函给你。 |
| 106102000 | Mm? a Tarnished, here? | ……哦，是褪色者啊。 |
| 106102010 | Thou must have some business in mind, to come all this way. | 你是为了什么，来到这里？ |
| 106102020 | Though I have no memory of inking thee an invitation. | ……我应该没有发邀请函给你。 |
| 106110000 | I see. Quite the sleuth, aren't we. | ……原来如此，调查得真仔细。 |
| 106110010 | Indeed, I am the witch Ranni. | 没错，我是魔女菈妮。 |

| 106110030 | I did it all. | 我是做过这些事。 |
| 106110040 | But sadly for thee, the cursemark thou seekest is not to be found here. | ……再来，你想找的咒痕，不在这里。 |
| 106110050 | I have slain the body I was born into, and cast it away. | 我杀害、抛弃与生俱来的身体── |

| 106111000 | Hah! | ……哈哈。 |
| 106111010 | And why should I reveal that to thee? | ……为什么非得告诉你？ |
| 106111020 | I performed the act not to bury the past, nor in shame of the deed, | 我不隐瞒过去，不为此感到后悔， |
| 106111030 | but all the same, thy begging compels me not a jot. | 但也不会有人乞讨就乐于施舍。 |
| 106111040 | The cursemark thou seekest is not here. That is all I will say. | ……你想找的咒痕不在这里，我言尽于此。 |
| 106111050 | Now, begone. | 好了，尽快离开。 |
| 106112000 | The cursemark thou seekest is not here. That is all I will say. | ……你想找的咒痕不在这里，我言尽于此。 |
| 106112010 | Now, begone. | 好了，尽快离开。 |
| 106113000 | Oh, is that so? | ……哦？ |

| 106113030 | ... | …… |
| 106113040 | Very well... | ……也行。 |
| 106113050 | There's nothing wrong with a well-laid scheme. | 我不讨厌心怀鬼胎的人。 |

| 106113070 | I am curious enough to see what thy destiny portends... | 这命运也颇有意思。 |
| 106113080 | I'll allow it. Enter my service. | 我准许你替我做事。 |

| 106120000 | Hah! | ……哈哈。 |
| 106120010 | No reason in particular, thou claimest? | 没事吗？这样啊。 |
| 106120020 | Intriguing. Then mayhaps fate hath steered thee to this reunion. | 倒有趣了。那我们在此重逢，可说是命运从中牵线。 |
| 106120030 | Intriguing. Then mayhaps fate hath steered thee to this encounter. | 倒有趣了。那我们在此邂逅，可说是命运从中牵线。 |
| 106120040 | ... | …… |
| 106120050 | Wilt thou enter into my service? | 你要替我做事吗？ |
| 106120060 | I am the witch Ranni. I stole Death long ago, and search now for the dark path. | 我是魔女菈妮。\n过去窃走死亡，如今找寻深入黑暗的路。 |

| 106121000 | I see. A choice well made. | ……这样啊，那很好。 |

| 106121020 | But I require as much of those under my command. | 但我的门槛也不过如此。 |

| 301002010 | It's no surprise. You poor have-nots are a stubborn lot. | 我想也是。\n这就是一无所有者的悲哀。 |
| 301002020 | Fine, then. | 好吧。 |
| 301002030 | If you must have a go at it, maidenless as you are, you'll require an education. | 如果没有女巫，还想要挣扎的话──\n那我来告诉你吧。 |
| 301002040 | On the ways of the learned Tarnished. | 什么是褪色者该有的作为。 |
| 301002050 | Are you familiar with grace? The golden light that gives life to you Tarnished. | 你知道赐福吧？\n就是让你们褪色者能稍事歇息的金光。 |
| 301002060 | You may also behold its golden rays pointing in a particular direction at times. | 那簇金光会产生光芒，指往某个方向── |
| 301002070 | That is the guidance of grace. The path that a Tarnished must travel. | 那正是所谓“赐福的指引”，褪色者该行进的道路。 |
| 301002080 | It's nothing short of a miracle. That the guidance of grace can lead you, | ……是啊，没有错，指引会告诉你。 |
| 301002090 | maidenless as you are, to the perfect place to die in obscurity. | 没有女巫的你，最后死得默默无名的地方。 |
| 301003000 | What's the matter? | 怎么了吗？ |
| 301003010 | Shouldn't you be off proving yourself, or some such? | 不是还打算继续挣扎吗？ |
| 301003020 | Then go on, take the hint and follow the guidance of grace. | 那就快朝赐福指引的方向前进， |
| 301003030 | To Castle Stormveil, on the cliff. | 前往断崖上的那座史东薇尔城。 |
| 301003040 | And if, by chance, you do find your way to the castle, | ……要是你有个万分之一的可能，抵达那座城， |
| 301003050 | you may receive a summons. To the famed Roundtable Hold… | 说不定连你也能受邀到圆桌厅堂…… |
| 301004000 | Guidance will show the way, most certainly. | ……我想赐福指引的方向， |
| 301004010 | To Castle Stormveil, over on the cliff. | 肯定是那座断崖上的城，史东薇尔。 |
| 301004020 | The home of the decrepit demigod, Godrick the Grafted. | 那座城是又老又丑的半神，“接肢”葛瑞克的居所。 |
| 301004030 | Although I'm afraid you'll never make it that far, hmm. | ……但像你这种人，根本没能耐抵达那座城吧。 |
| 301004040 | Rest assured, I sympathise, deeply. There's no worse fate than to be maidenless. | 唉，我很同情你。\n没有女巫的陪伴，看了真让人于心不忍。 |
| 301004050 | Oh, but if, by chance, you do find your way to the castle, | ……噢，不过啊。\n要是你有个万分之一的可能，抵达那座城， |
| 301004060 | you may receive a summons. To the famed Roundtable Hold… | 说不定连你也能受邀到圆桌厅堂…… |
| 301011000 | Oh, yes... Tarnished, are we? | ……噢，你是……是褪色者吧？ |
| 301011010 | Come to the Lands Between for the Elden Ring, hmm? | 渴求艾尔登法环，因此来到这块交界地。 |
| 301011020 | Of course you have. No shame in it. | 我全都知道，事情肯定是如此。 |

| 301011040 | Without guidance, without the strength of runes, and without an invitation to the Roundtable Hold... | 不知引导在何方，无法获得卢恩的力量，\n更不可能受邀到圆桌厅堂…… |
| 301011050 | You are fated, it seems, to die in obscurity. | 只能死得默默无名吧。 |
| 301012000 | Luckily for you, however, there is one shining ray of hope for even the maidenless. | ……即使你没有女巫，也还有一丝希望── |
| 301012010 | Me. Varré. Take care to listen. | 因为你遇到了我，梵雷。 |
| 301012020 | Are you familiar with grace? The golden light that gives life to you Tarnished. | 你知道赐福吧？\n就是让你们褪色者能稍事歇息的金光。 |
| 301012030 | You may also behold its golden rays pointing in a particular direction at times. | 那簇金光会产生光芒，指往某个方向── |
| 301012040 | That is the guidance of grace. The path that a Tarnished must travel. | 那正是所谓“赐福的指引”，褪色者该行进的道路。 |
| 301012050 | Mm, indeed. Grace's guidance holds the answers. | ……对，没错。指引会告诉你── |
| 301012060 | It will lead you Tarnished to the path you are meant to follow. | 褪色者该往什么方向去…… |
| 301012070 | Even if it leads you to your grave. | 或是该葬身何处。 |
| 301013000 | Grace's guidance will reveal the path forward, most certainly. | ……我想赐福指引的方向， |
| 301013010 | To Castle Stormveil, over on the cliff. | 肯定是那座断崖上的城，史东薇尔。 |
| 301013020 | The home of the decrepit demigod, Godrick the Grafted. | 那座城是又老又丑的半神，“接肢”葛瑞克的居所。 |
| 301014000 | It's time you set off, I should think. | ……快动身吧。 |
| 301014010 | To Castle Stormveil, on the cliff, where grace would guide you. | 前往指引提示的方向，那座断崖上的史东薇尔城。 |
| 301014020 | If you seek the Elden Ring, maidenless as you are. | 没有女巫陪伴也渴求艾尔登法环的话，就该如此。 |
| 301020000 | Ohh, well done, well done indeed. | ……噢，等你很久了。 |
| 301020010 | You made it through that entire mess, all the way to Stormveil. | 看来历经一番折腾，你抵达史东薇尔了。 |
| 301020020 | And off you trotted to the Roundtable Hold… My sincerest congratulations. | 而且也受邀到圆桌厅堂……恭喜你。 |
| 301020030 | But, how did you find the Roundtable? | ……那么，看到圆桌厅堂，有什么感想呢？ |
| 301020040 | Oh, you don't have to say it. | 噢，不必说出口，我也明白。 |
| 301020050 | Before, the Roundtable was chock full of venerated warriors, but now, it's home to puff-chests and has-beens. | 过去英雄云集的圆桌厅堂，如今也徒留垃圾残渣。 |
| 301020060 | I fear you've been terribly disappointed. | 你是不是感到失望？ |
| 301020070 | I don't blame you. But still, the Roundtable has its perks. | 我能体会。只是现况如此，\n如果你还是认为这对自己有所帮助…… |
| 301020080 | Why not earn a seat? Fly straight and true, so to speak. | 那首先，要不要立下目标──\n成为圆桌厅堂真正的一员呢？ |
| 301021000 | Ahh, then you're interested? A wise choice indeed. | 噢，你有意愿啊，真是了不起。 |
| 301021010 | To join the Roundtable proper, you must acquire a Great Rune, and request audience... | 要成为圆桌厅堂真正的一员，\n必须要拥有大卢恩，还需要…… |
| 301021020 | ...with the Two Fingers, in the inner chamber. | 觐见位于厅堂最深处房间的双指。 |
| 301021030 | They are the purported masters of the grace that guides your kind, the Tarnished. | 那位是为你们褪色者降下指引赐福的尊者。 |
| 301021040 | Mm, yes, pay them a visit, so that you may see for yourself. | 对，所以你有必要觐见祂、知道祂。 |
| 301022000 | Challenge Godrick the Grafted, lord of Stormveil, to acquire a Great Rune. | 至于大卢恩，去挑战史东薇尔的城主，\n“接肢”葛瑞克吧。 |
| 301022010 | Decrepit, he may be, but a demigod he remains. And of course, an inheritor of a Great Rune. | 即使又老又丑，那也还是个半神，\n也是拥有大卢恩的碎片君王。 |
| 301022020 | Worse yet, I hear old Godrick's acquired a ferocious new toy to graft... | ……不过这阵子，听说葛瑞克\n拿到了相当致命的接肢祭品。 |
| 301022030 | So. Prepare for the worst. | 你要当心啊。 |
| 301023000 | ... | …… |
| 301023010 | Yes, I see. Perhaps it's just as well. | 是吗？唉，我想也是吧。 |
| 301023020 | Besides, you are maidenless. One can only do so much with the materials provided. | 你没有女巫陪伴，本质就是脱队的瑕疵品。 |
| 301023030 | But then again, if you should realise the error of your ways, | 但如果这决定只是一时糊涂，你回心转意了， |
| 301023040 | I'm always willing to hear you out. | 再来找我吧。 |
| 301024000 | Oh, have you decided to have a go after all? At joining the Roundtable proper? | ……噢，你回心转意，\n想成为圆桌厅堂的真正一员了？ |
| 301025000 | What's the matter? | 怎么了吗？ |

| 301025020 | Then you must face Godrick the Grafted, lord of Stormveil, | 那就快去挑战史东薇尔的城主，“接肢”葛瑞克…… |
| 301025030 | for without a Great Rune, you will not be granted audience. | 取得大卢恩之后， |
| 301025040 | With the Two Fingers, in the inner chamber. | 觐见位于圆桌厅堂，最深处房间的双指。 |
| 301026000 | Ohh, well done, well done indeed. | ……噢，等你很久了。 |
| 301026010 | You bested Godrick the Grafted, and claimed a Great Rune. | 成功打倒“接肢”葛瑞克，取得大卢恩了啊。 |

| 301026030 | My congratulations. | 恭喜你。 |
| 301026040 | Now, visit the Roundtable Hold. | ……那么，请前往圆桌厅堂吧。 |
| 301026050 | For an audience with the Two Fingers, in the inner chamber. | 到最深处的房间，觐见双指。 |
| 301027000 | Go to the Roundtable Hold. | ……请前往圆桌厅堂吧。 |
| 301027010 | For an audience with the Two Fingers, in the inner chamber. | 到最深处的房间，觐见双指。 |
| 301030000 | Ah, there you are. | ……噢，等你很久了。 |
| 301030010 | You claimed a Great Rune, and had your audience. With the Two Fingers, at the Roundtable Hold. | 不仅成功取得了大卢恩，\n也觐见了圆桌厅堂的双指。 |
| 301030020 | You've had your audience. With the Two Fingers, at the Roundtable Hold. | 看来你觐见了圆桌厅堂的双指。 |
| 301030030 | What was your impression? | 那么，你有什么想法？ |
| 301031000 | Ah-ha, your intuition serves you well. | ……你果然也有感觉啊。 |
| 301031010 | My doubts had been piling up, you see. | 老实说，我也有同感。 |
| 301031020 | ...The words of the Two Fingers cannot be trusted. | ……双指的话不能相信。 |
| 301031030 | Truly, naught but rambling, senile delusions. | 仿佛是上了年纪的老人在说满口空话…… |
| 301031040 | I believe, that when the Elden Ring was shattered, the Two Fingers were corrupted, their guidance; skewed. | 我心里是这么想的：当艾尔登法环破碎之际，\n双指与祂的指引是否也同样毁坏了？ |
| 301031050 | Even worse, the Fingers harbor no love for our kind. | 而且，我感受不到双指对我们的爱── |
| 301031060 | That's the part that irks the most. | 这是我最不能忍受的部分。 |
| 301032000 | Oh, I have a gift for you, something fit only for the wise. | 噢，还有一件事。\n有件物品想要送给聪颖的你。 |
| 301033000 | A means for circumventing the draw of the Two Fingers. | ……这是可以摆脱双指指引的手段， |
| 301033010 | Give it a try, won't you? | 请你务必一试。 |
| 301033020 | And if it please you, may we meet again. | 如果你对此感到满意，我们再见面吧。 |
| 301033030 | I've high hopes for you. My lambkin. | 我很期待再会呢，亲爱的。 |
| 301034000 | You don't say. Well, what a relief that must be. | ……原来如此，那很好。 |
| 301034010 | You may go, then. My work here is done. | 那么请你出发吧，我的使命已经达成。 |
| 301034020 | May the wisdom of the Two Fingers guide you. | 愿你有双指的指引。 |
| 301035000 | Oh? Is something wrong? | 嗯？有什么事吗？ |
| 301036000 | Be sure to try that finger I gave you. | ……送给你的那手指，请务必一试。 |
| 301036010 | There's no reason to dither. | 你根本不需要犹豫── |
| 301036020 | The Tarnished were spurned by grace, forsaken by the Two Fingers. And now they ask you to mend their crumbling world? | 赐福跟双指都曾对褪色者弃之不顾……\n等到面临毁灭了，又向你们求助。 |
| 301036030 | Hah, your loyalties are misplaced with them. | 对于这种存在，哪有必要讲求情义？ |

| 301037010 | I'm quite certain that you'll take to it. | 你肯定会感到满意。 |
| 301050000 | Oh, lambkin, so pleased you're here. | 啊，亲爱的，你来啦。 |
| 301050010 | I'm glad that you're enjoying my gift. | 看来你很喜欢我送的礼物。 |
| 301050020 | Mmm, I knew it from the very start. | 噢，和我料想的一样， |
| 301050030 | You have a taste for noble blood. | 尊贵之血和你实在太相配了。 |
| 301050040 | ... | …… |
| 301050050 | I wish to anoint you a proper inductee. | 我想要邀请你成为我们的正式成员── |
| 301050060 | A knight to serve Luminary Mohg, the Lord of Blood, and establish a new dynasty. | 成为“鲜血君王”蒙格大人的骑士，\n与我们一同建立新王朝。 |
| 301050070 | Luminary Mohg has strength, vision, and of course, love. | 蒙格大人不只有强大的力量与信念，\n也满怀着爱。 |
| 301050080 | So, what do you say, my lambkin? | 想必答案呼之欲出了吧，亲爱的？ |
| 301051000 | Mm, yes, who would have it any other way? | 没错，我想也只有这种答案。 |
| 301051010 | Now, take this. | 那么，请收下这个吧。 |
| 301051020 | For your final trial. Soak the cloth with a maiden's blood. | 这是最后的试炼──请用那块布浸满女巫的血。 |
| 301051030 | Normally, this ritual would involve killing one's own maiden, and recanting the wisdom of the Two Fingers. | 这仪式原本是杀害自己的女巫，\n代表与双指的指引就此诀别…… |
| 301051040 | But since you are maidenless, the blood of anyone's maiden will do. | 但因为你没有女巫，所以用其他女巫的血也无妨。 |

| 301054020 | And with this, you are a formal inductee. | 如此一来，你就是我们正式的成员── |
| 301054030 | A knight who will assist Luminary Mohg, the Lord of Blood, in the establishment of a new dynasty. | 与“鲜血君王”蒙格大人一同建立新王朝的骑士。 |
| 301054040 | Now, give me your finger. | 来吧，请伸出你的手指。 |

| 301054100 | You have the sweetest scream. My lambkin. | 刚才的惨叫真是动听啊，亲爱的。 |
| 301055000 | Oh, another thing. You should have this. | 啊，对了。我要把这个交给你。 |

| 301057000 | Ahh, it is trying, but we must be patient. | 噢，真教人迫不及待啊。 |

| 301057030 | Ha ha ha... | 呵呵呵。 |
| 301058000 | The cloth is your final trial. Soak it with the blood of a maiden. | 交给你的布是用在最后的试炼──\n用那块布浸满女巫的血吧。 |
| 301058010 | The blood of anyone's maiden will do. You are maidenless, after all. | ……用任一女巫的血都可以喔，因为你没有女巫嘛。 |

| 301080010 | Did you come seeking violence, upon learning my esteemed position under Luminary Mohg? | 我是光芒万丈的蒙格大人的重臣，\n你是知道，才如此放肆？ |
| 301080020 | I'll take pleasure in ensuring you regret this. | ……我会让你悔不当初。 |
| 301080030 | Before you die in obscurity. | 死得默默无名吧。 |
| 301081000 | You seek violence, heedless of my warning, though you have been raised to a knight of the dynasty? | ……身为王朝的骑士，对警告充耳不闻，\n还做出如此蛮横的行为。 |
| 301081010 | I am pained, to the very depths of my being. | 我打从心底对你感到失望。 |
| 301081020 | I'll ensure you regret this, my lambkin. | ……亲爱的，我会让你悔不当初。 |
| 301081030 | Enjoy your miserable death. | 接受横死的下场吧。 |
| 301082000 | How dare you trouble Luminary Mohg's passions. | ……不准让蒙格大人的心有一丝烦忧， |
| 301082010 | You vulgar churl. | 下等的瑕疵品。 |
| 301083000 | I made a grave error. | ……我真是犯下了大错。 |
| 301084000 | Why must I be... | ……我为什么…… |
| 301084010 | Disgraced by this lowborn... | 会败给这种瑕疵品…… |
| 301085000 | O...Luminary...Mohg... | ……蒙格大人……蒙格大人…… |
| 301085010 | Please grant...the strength...you promised... | 请您赐予小的，那股力量…… |
| 301085020 | I have given...everything... | 小的已经竭尽全力…… |
| 301085030 | Please...my lord... | 蒙格大人，求求您…… |
| 301086000 | Please, answer me...Luminary...Mohg. | ……蒙格大人，您为什么保持沉默？ |
| 301086010 | ... | …… |
| 301086020 | A-ahh... | 啊啊……啊啊啊…… |

| 301800000 | Oh? | 哦？ |

| 320034060 | I'm still looking for my own purpose. | 我想找找其他自己能做的事。 |

| 320035010 | I'm still looking for my own purpose. | 我想找找其他自己能做的事。 |

| 320040000 | Good to see you again. Thank you very much! | 啊，谢谢你。 |
| 320040010 | I have you to thank, don't I? For persuading Master Hewg? | 你替我说服修古先生了，对吧？ |

| 320051000 | I feel like I'm really coming to grips with spirit tuning of late. | 这阵子，我开始熟悉调灵的工作了── |
| 320051010 | I can see how and why immortal essence exists as spirit under the Golden Order. | 灵魂具有的不死特质，在律法之下会是如何运作， |

| 320052010 | Can you take this little one along with you? | 我想请你带着这孩子一起旅行。 |

| 320052030 | They can't be summoned here. | 毕竟在这个地方也不能召唤出来， |

| 320052050 | It'll be glad of your company, I think, the little'un. | 我想这孩子也会很开心。 |
| 320052060 | They'd be glad of your company, I think, the little'uns. | 我想这些孩子也会很开心。 |
| 320053000 | I need to warn you about something. | ……有件事情，我想和你说一声。 |
| 320053010 | A little while ago someone started lurking in the wing on the opposite side of the roundtable. | 在不久以前，隔着圆桌的另一侧，\n更往里面走的地方，好像有人来了。 |
| 320053020 | And I can hear, from all the way over there... | ……即使隔了这么远的距离，我还是能听到── |
| 320053030 | The howling and wailing of spirits in fear of a curse. I can even hear the repulsive, twisted malison itself... | 灵魂发出的悲叹、哭喊，害怕诅咒的声音，\n也能感觉到恐怖、疯狂的诅咒。 |
| 320053040 | A plethora of spirits in an unceasing cacophony... | 那群灵魂为数众多，声音也不曾停息。 |
| 320053050 | I can't even imagine. How much suffering, inflicted to who knows how many souls... | 我实在无法想象──会有这种情况，\n到底是什么样的人，做了什么样的事情？ |
| 320053060 | Not even the grafting caused anything like this to happen... | ……即使做出“接肢”恶行，也不会如此。 |
| 320053070 | You should keep your distance. | ……我认为不该靠近那里。 |
| 320053080 | I know you're strong, but please... | 就算你很强大，也不该贸然接近。 |

| 320054010 | The howling and wailing of spirits in fear of the curse. I can even hear the repulsive, twisted malison itself... | 灵魂发出的悲叹、哭喊，害怕诅咒的声音，\n也能感觉到恐怖、疯狂的诅咒。 |
| 320054020 | You should keep your distance. | ……我认为不该靠近那里。 |
| 320054030 | I know you're strong, but please... | 就算你很强大，也不该贸然接近。 |
| 320055000 | I can't hear them any more; the voices of the spirits cowering from the curse... | 之前和你提过的，灵魂害怕诅咒发出的声音，\n现在已经听不见了。 |
| 320055010 | I suppose the Dung Eater must have left the Roundtable. | 食粪者先生已经离开圆桌厅堂了吗？ |

| 320056000 | Be on your guard, I beg you. | ……请多加小心。 |

| 320056020 | I can hear them; the spirits as they howl and lament in fear of the curse. | 我能听见，灵魂发出的悲叹、哭喊，害怕诅咒的声音。 |
| 320056030 | And worse than ever, the reverberations of the twisted malison itself. | 还能感觉到那恐怖、疯狂的诅咒，又增强了几分。 |

| 320057010 | But it isn't like last time. | 但是这一次和上一次的情况不同， |
| 320057020 | I'm almost certain...the spirits have escaped their confinement. | 我觉得灵魂一定是摆脱禁锢，逃出来了。 |

| 321004040 | First he hid himself amongst the womenfolk to flee the capital, then hid from Radahn in that castle... | 战败之后混在女人堆里逃出王城，\n忌惮拉塔恩，躲在城里一个气也不敢吭。 |

| 324040030 | Though a mere axe-wielding barbarian, her youthful credulity suited my purposes. | 虽然是个只懂得挥舞斧头的野人，\n但那孩童一般，对人深信不疑的性格，实在可爱。 |
| 324040040 | So I put her to work. | 所以我让她替我做事。 |
| 324040050 | Do not hesitate to employ her, should her services benefit you. | ……如果有她能帮忙的，就让她出力吧。 |
| 324040060 | Despite her looks, she is more than capable in the press of battle. | 你看到她的外表可能会怀疑，但她确实有实力。 |
| 324041000 | Ahh, you've already heard? | ……哦，这件事你知情啊？ |
| 324041010 | Indeed, it seemed the whelp harboured suspicions. | 对，既然她开始心存疑念…… |
| 324041020 | So I had no further use for her. | 那就没用处了。 |
| 324041030 | Honestly, what's a man to do. | ……实在恼人。 |
| 324041040 | A determined plebian is more wicked than an Omen horn, quite frankly. | 无知者的意志是毒瘤，\n恶质到连恶兆的角都显得逊色。 |
| 324041050 | I suspect...that's just what the Queen wants. | ……但我猜想，可能女王盼的也是如此── |
| 324041060 | A dose of ambition, to incite the Tarnished. | 我们褪色者的相互猜忌。 |
| 324042000 | Is that potion what I think it is? | ……哦，你手上的那种药…… |
| 324042010 | Bloody Seluvis. I suppose he's up to something again. | 赛尔维斯那厮，恶习又犯了。 |
| 324042020 | Oh, I won't interfere. You go ahead and do what you must. | 啊，无妨。你也有自己的做事方式。 |
| 324042030 | The Roundtable has no code to speak of. | 圆桌厅堂无意约束任何人。 |
| 324042040 | But, I ask you this. Are you really going to do the bidding of that twisted dolly botherer? | 但是啊，你打算任凭那令人不悦的男人摆布？ |
| 324042050 | Or would you rather hand that potion to me, and see if we can't get one over on the bastard? | 还是说，你愿意把药交给我，\n假装自己有照他的意思行事？ |
| 324043000 | Good. I'll dispose of the potion myself. | ……很好。药交给我善后。 |
| 324043010 | You go and see Seluvis, but don't give anything away. | 你只要装作不知情，回报赛尔维斯就好── |
| 324043020 | Just tell him that you tricked your mark into drinking the potion as planned. | “确实让对方喝下了。” |
| 324043030 | Despite knowing next to bloody nothing, he's so far up his own arse he won't suspect a thing. | 那厮绝对不会察觉。重要的事情他一概不知，\n那书痴连发生这种事的可能性都不曾推想过。 |
| 324043040 | His inevitable display of arrogance will certainly be a sight to behold. | 好好欣赏他自大的滑稽样吧。 |
| 324044000 | Well, I won't force you. | ……嗯，我不会强求。 |
| 324044010 | But I think your plan would be a dreadful waste. | 但难道，你不觉得可惜？ |
| 324044020 | She's not herself right now, and though I have no need of her, she still has potential. | 尽管那女娃儿不合我的心意，现在又是那副样子，\n但她的确是未经琢磨的原石。 |
| 324044030 | Certainly more value than she'd have as a bloody puppet. | ……那样的她，竟然要变成无趣的傀儡啊。 |
| 324045000 | I hear you helped get the girl back on her feet. | ……那女娃儿受你照顾了。 |
| 324045010 | Though I'm not her foster father anymore, I'd still like to thank you. | 我毕竟曾是义父，该向你致谢。 |
| 324045020 | Sorry. For the time you had to waste. | ……不好意思，浪费你不少的时间。 |
| 324046000 | Well, I won't force you. | ……嗯，我不会强求。 |
| 324046010 | If you want to do that dolly botherer's bidding, that's up to you. | 你愿意接受那男人摆布，也是种选择。 |
| 324046020 | Not that I could fathom why you'd want to... | 只是我无法理解罢了…… |
| 324050000 | Oh, my apologies for that nasty business. | ……啊，发生那件事，我深感抱歉。 |
| 324050010 | Ensha got rather ahead of himself, it seems. | 恩夏实在太过急躁。 |
| 324050020 | As his master, I'd like to express my regret. | 身为他的主人，向你致上歉意。 |
| 324050030 | But now, Ensha is slain and gone. | 但又说来，恩夏战败、赔上性命── |
| 324050040 | Finished, forever more. | 实在是无药可救啊。 |
| 324051000 | Ah, yes, by way of apology, | ……啊，为了表示歉意， |
| 324051010 | allow me to tender some advice, in regard to the half of the secret medallion you possess. | 我来提供情报吧──\n关于你拿到的秘密符节，它的另一半边的情报。 |
| 324051020 | Find the Albinauric woman. | ……去找白金之子的女人吧。 |
| 324051030 | She hides in a cave to the west of the Laskyar Ruins which jut from the mist-shrouded lake of Liurnia, | 那女人躲在利耶尼亚的雾湖，\n拉斯卡废墟西边的洞窟内， |
| 324051040 | She knows the location of the medallion's counterpart, I am sure. | 她肯定知道另一半的秘密符节在哪里。 |
| 324051050 | together with her great wolf. | 和她的大狼一起行动。 |
| 324052000 | Find the Albinauric woman. | ……去找白金之子的女人吧。 |
| 324052010 | She hides in a cave to the west of the Laskyar Ruins which jut from the mist-shrouded lake of Liurnia, | 那女人躲在利耶尼亚的雾湖，\n拉斯卡废墟西边的洞窟内， |
| 324052020 | She knows the location of the medallion's counterpart, I am sure. | 她肯定知道另一半的秘密符节在哪里。 |
| 324052030 | together with her great wolf. | 和她的大狼一起行动。 |
| 324053000 | Ah, yes, by way of apology, | ……啊，为了表示歉意， |
| 324053010 | allow me to tender some advice, in regard to the half of the secret medallion you possess. | 我来提供情报吧──\n关于你拿到的秘密符节，它的另一半边的情报。 |
| 324053020 | Find the village of the Albinaurics. | ……去找白金村吧。 |
| 324053030 | It lies to the southwest of Liurnia, below the Altar clifflands. | 白金村就在利耶尼亚的西南边，祭坛悬崖的下方。 |
| 324053040 | And some of the old village folk have hidden the secret medallion's other half somewhere. | ……那另一半边的秘密符节，\n应该是村里的那群老人把它藏了起来。 |
| 324054000 | Find the village of the Albinaurics. | ……去找白金村吧。 |
| 324054010 | It lies to the southwest of Liurnia, below the Altar clifflands. | 白金村就在利耶尼亚的西南边，祭坛悬崖的下方。 |
| 324054020 | Some of the old village folk have hidden the secret medallion's other half somewhere. | ……那另一半边的秘密符节，\n应该是村里的那群老人把它藏了起来。 |
| 324060000 | Ahh, I know already. You're after it too, aren't you. | ……嗯，我当然知道，你的目标也一样。 |
| 324060010 | To pass the impenetrable thorns, you seek the forge of the flame of ruin, in the snowy mountaintops of the giants. | 你想穿过拒绝的刺，所以要前往\n积着厚雪的巨人山顶，抵达灰灭火焰的大锅。 |
| 324060020 | Then you need to reach the Grand Lift of Rold, beyond the forbidden region. | ……既然如此，你该朝禁域前头的洛德大升降机前进。 |
| 324060030 | Hah, no need to pay me for that gift. | 不需要道谢，别客气。 |
| 324060040 | All my knowledge is for the sake of guidance. | 我的知识全为了引导而在， |
| 324060050 | That a Tarnished might stand before the Elden Ring, and become Elden Lord. | 也是为了让褪色者觐见艾尔登法环，\n成为艾尔登之王而在。 |
| 324060060 | It doesn't have to be me, my fellow. | ……达成这些伟业的，不必是我本人。 |
| 324061000 | If you're heading to the forge of the flame of ruin, in the snowy mountaintops of the giants. | ……想前往积着厚雪的巨人山顶，\n抵达灰灭火焰的大锅， |
| 324061010 | You'll need to find the Grand Lift of Rold, beyond the forbidden region. | 你该朝禁域前头的洛德大升降机前进。 |
| 324061020 | I marked your map with its location. | ……刚才我已经在你的地图上注记。 |
| 324061030 | Go, if you would. Take no heed of "cardinal sin". | 做出这些行为等同犯下重罪，\n但你还是出发吧。 |
| 324061040 | The Two Fingers lost their purpose a long, long time ago. | ……早在很久以前，双指就已经毁坏了。 |
| 324070000 | Ahh, I see you've laid your hands on the other secret medallion. | ……哦，两个秘密符节，你都拿到手了？ |
| 324070010 | I'm glad to see my counsel has borne fruit, but the honour of the deed is yours alone. | 我很庆幸先前的情报有帮上忙……\n但话说回来，你真的很出色。 |
| 324070020 | You've made more of yourself than Ensha has... | 比起恩夏，更是出色…… |
| 324070030 | Now, more importantly, both secret medallions are in your hands. | 总之，现在总算凑齐了秘密符节。 |
| 324070040 | I suppose you'd like to know then? What awaits you on the path ahead? | 你想知道前头会有什么等着你吧？ |
| 324070050 | Me too, my friend, me too. I wait with baited breath. | 对，我也很想知道。我很期待。 |
| 324071000 | Ahh, so the secret medallions led you to the land of the Haligtree? | ……果然如此。秘密符节带你前进的地方，\n是圣树的所在地。 |
| 324071010 | I'd expect to find Malenia there. She who fought Radahn to a standstill. | 和拉塔恩战成平手的玛莲妮亚，人应该就在那。 |
| 324071020 | Well, if the scarlet rot hasn't eaten her away completely. | ……前提是，她没有因为猩红腐败自毁的话。 |
| 324071030 | But...with the Haligtree as it is... | ……只是说，圣树的那模样…… |
| 324071040 | I suppose Miquella must already be... | 米凯拉可能已经…… |
| 324072000 | Ah, my apologies. Lost myself, for a moment there. | 啊，抱歉，我自顾自地陷入沉思。 |
| 324072010 | The information you've shared is of great value. As promised, your reward: | 你的情报很有价值，如同我们约定的── |
| 324072020 | A hidden treasure, known only to me. | 我愿意提供给你，只有我知道的秘密宝藏。 |
| 324072030 | A secret rite known only to me. | 我愿意提供给你，只有我知道的秘术。 |
| 324072040 | You are a true fellow. All I ask is that you remain constant. | ……你是我如假包换的同志。\n希望我们可以一直长久合作。 |
| 324072530 | And it is a wondrous thing indeed. | 我愿意提供给你特殊的物品。 |
| 324073000 | So. The Haligtree, now but a husk... | ……原来啊。圣树果真变成空壳了。 |
| 324073010 | I heard speculation Miquella embedded himself in the Haligtree, | 听说米凯拉原本寄宿在圣树之中， |
| 324073020 | but before he could finish, someone cut the tree open and absconded with his infant form. | 然而在他完全寄宿以前，\n有人剖开圣树，夺走其中的稚子。 |
| 324073030 | Indeed, it seems those words held weight. | ……看样子，那件事不假。 |
| 324073040 | How vexing. That the All-knowing didn't have the full story... | ……真是棘手。\n居然会有百智爵士无从知晓全貌的事。 |
| 324073050 | Perhaps the Queen's sorrow was justified... | 也难怪女王会感到烦忧…… |
| 324074000 | Oh, so that's where the so-called Lord of Blood was hiding himself eh. | ……哦，那名叫鲜血君王的，竟然藏身在那种地方。 |
| 324074010 | A fitting little squat for that deluded maniac to bleat about the revival of his precious dynasty,\nwhile he turns our fellow Tarnished into Bloody Fingers. | 意图将我们褪色者化为血指，\n满怀着复兴王朝的夸张妄想，那地底倒是很适合他。 |
| 324074020 | Let him stay there. That way, his delusions will remain as they are - distant and unattainable. | ……他继续蛰伏地底倒也好。\n如此一来妄想只会是妄想，也是永远的美梦。 |
| 324074030 | But perhaps it's worth looking into... | ……话说回来，这听来有调查的必要。 |
| 324074040 | If what I've heard is right, then maybe... | 如果那件事不假，有可能…… |
| 324075000 | Ahh, I see! So Miquella was with the Lord of Blood after all! | ……哦哦，原来啊！\n米凯拉果真在鲜血君王的身旁吗？ |
| 324075010 | That is some fine intelligence indeed! | 你啊，这可是天大的情报。 |
| 324075020 | With it, the final clue has been brought into the light. | 圆桌厅堂，不，该说是我个人该知道的，\n这是最后一件了。 |
| 324075030 | One of the last few pieces the Roundtable-- I need, to put everything together. | 那条线索总算明朗了。 |
| 324075040 | As promised, allow me to impart to you | ……依照我们的约定，我愿意提供给你── |
| 324075050 | the last of the hidden treasures known only to me. | 只有我知道的秘密宝藏，其中最上等的一个。 |
| 324075060 | the last of the secret rites known only to me. | 只有我知道的秘术，其中最上等的一个。 |
| 324075070 | a thing most wondrous, known only to me. | 只有我知道的特殊物品。 |
| 324076000 | Well, I wonder what comes next... | ……嗯，接下来该怎么做…… |
| 324076010 | If he continues his slumber within the cocoon, all would be well. | 让他继续沉眠茧中，也是不错。 |
| 324076020 | But perhaps it would be safer to destroy it. | 但也许该消灭他才是。 |
| 324076030 | Miquella is the one thing that remains a mystery to me... | ……米凯拉，蒙着一层面纱的存在…… |
| 324077000 | You...burned the Erdtree, didn't you? | ……你燃烧了黄金树吧？ |
| 324077010 | Then the Roundtable is soon to follow. | 看来圆桌厅堂就快画下句点。 |
| 324077020 | Ah, no need to fret about that. | 哦，不必放在心上。 |
| 324077030 | The Roundtable Hold served to put a Tarnished upon the throne of Elden Lord. | 圆桌厅堂本来就是\n为了让褪色者成为艾尔登之王而设。 |
| 324077040 | And if the Erdtree needed to burn for that to happen, | 如果为此必须燃烧黄金树， |
| 324077050 | then the Roundtable must go, as well. | 那圆桌厅堂画下句点，也是必然。 |
| 324078000 | I'll stay at the Roundtable, for a time. | ……我会暂时留在圆桌厅堂。 |
| 324078010 | I must learn all that can be taken from this place, | 我必须把放在这里，该知晓的一切记在脑海。 |
| 324078020 | and sear it into my memory. | 必须把这一切刻划在心中。 |
| 324078030 | How could I call myself the All-Knowing, if I did any less? | ……“百智爵士”的含意，正是如此。 |
| 324079000 | The pursuit of knowledge is without end, for knowledge is never a thing complete. | ……知识无穷，但也不尽完美。 |
| 324079010 | Thus, I maintain the mantle of All-Knowing. | 也因此，我能一直是“百智爵士”。 |
| 324079020 | Perhaps the same could be said of guidance. | 试想，这可能与引导很雷同。 |
| 324079030 | Who's to say whether we'll remain who we are, once the fight is finished? | 在战争结束之后，我们还有办法维持本性吗？ |
| 324079040 | What do you think, as one who aspires to become Elden Lord? | ……想成为艾尔登之王的人啊，你有什么想法？ |
| 324080000 | Ahh, I knew you'd come. | ……啊，结果真的是你。 |
| 324080010 | To stand before the Elden Ring. To become Elden Lord. | 准备觐见艾尔登法环，成为艾尔登之王吗。 |
| 324080020 | What a sad state of affairs. | ……不胜唏嘘啊。 |
| 324080030 | I commend your spirit, but alas, none shall take the throne. | 我认同你的意志，\n但要让你得偿所愿是另当别论。 |
| 324080040 | Queen Marika has high hopes for us. | 因为玛莉卡女王希望我们做的， |
| 324080050 | That we continue to struggle. Unto eternity. | 是维持现状，不停挣扎啊。 |
| 324100000 | You think I don't know what that is? | ……我这等人物，会不知道这是什么？ |
| 324100010 | I have no secrets for you to salaciously gawp at. | 我没有让你窥视的秘密。 |
| 324100020 | You think too little of Gideon Ofnir, the All-knowing. | ……劝你不要小看我“百智爵士”基甸·奥夫尼尔。 |
| 324800000 | My fellow, you've fought well, until now. | ……同志啊，到目前为止，\n你的战果确实不凡。 |
| 324801000 | I know...in my bones... | ……我全都知道。 |
| 324801010 | A Tarnished cannot become a Lord. Not even you. | 褪色者无法成为王，即使是你也一样。 |
| 324801020 | A man cannot kill a god... | ……人类，杀不了神。 |
| 324900100 | Knowledge above all! | 百智的世界啊！ |
| 325001000 | Ah, nice to meet you. | ……我们是第一次见面吧？ |
| 325001010 | The pleasure's mine. Rogier's the name. A sorcerer, as you might have guessed. | 你好，我是罗杰尔。\n正如你所想的，我是魔法师。 |
| 325001020 | I'm looking for a little something, here in the castle. | 我想找的物品就在这座城里， |
| 325001030 | When I'm not hotfooting it from the troops, that is. | 所以一直在躲避士兵的追缉。 |
| 325001040 | But enough about me, what are you doing here in Stormveil Castle? | ……话说回来，你为什么来到史东薇尔呢？ |
| 325001050 | This place is bristling with Tarnished hunters, you know. They sacrifice our kind, for grafting. | 这座城的人都在狩猎褪色者，\n拿来当作“接肢”的祭品， |
| 325001060 | Not exactly a place I'd stroll into without a purpose in mind... | 正常来说，应该不会主动靠近吧…… |
| 325002000 | I see. Here to challenge Godrick, and lay your hands upon a Great Rune, are you? | 原来是这样，你是为了获得大卢恩，\n跑来挑战葛瑞克啊…… |
| 325002010 | You can see it then, I take it? The guidance of grace. | 所以你看得到赐福的指引？ |
| 325002020 | Well, enjoy it while you can. | ……真羡慕你。 |
| 325002030 | I'm Tarnished, like you. | 我也跟你一样是褪色者， |
| 325002040 | But unlike you, I've seen neither hide nor hair of this guidance for the longest time. | 只是已经很久没再看过指引。 |
| 325002050 | Still, I won't forget how it felt when I first came here, to the Lands Between. | 不过，当时来到交界地的初心，\n我还是牢牢记在心底。 |
| 325002060 | I'm privy to a few magical battle arts. | ……我知道几招魔法相关的战技。 |
| 325002070 | Would you care to learn one? | 如果你愿意的话，要不要学看看？ |
| 325002080 | As a fellow Tarnished, once guided by grace. I'd love to help you out, if it please. | 我也是受过赐福指引的褪色者，\n想以这种身分帮助你。 |
| 325003000 | Oh? Keen to learn another battle art, are we? | 哦？又想再学习战技吗？ |
| 325004000 | Oh hello there, good to see you safe. | 嗨，你好啊。平安无事就好。 |
| 325004010 | Stopping by to learn a battle art or two? | 要来学习战技吗？ |
| 325005000 | The battle art you've learned is of the glintstone family. | ……你学习的战技是归在辉石魔法之下── |
| 325005010 | They were conceived at the great Academy of Raya Lucaria, to the north of this castle. | 据说是出自这座城北方的雷亚卢卡利亚，\n有一间规模庞大的学院…… |
| 325005020 | In the past, they obeyed laws which contravened the Golden Order, or so I'm told. | 听说从很久以前开始，\n他们就遵循着与黄金律法完全对立的法则。 |
| 325005030 | Fascinating, isn't it? | ……这件事情真的很有意思。 |
| 325005040 | That the Golden Order was pliable enough to absorb practices that contradicted itself in the past. | 以前的黄金律法十分宽大，\n连完全对立的法则都能够包容。 |
| 325005050 | With the Order broken, twisted, and in need of repair, | 在黄金律法破碎、扭曲，必须被修复的现在…… |
| 325005060 | such adaptability is more important now than ever. | 我认为这种特质，真的是万分重要。 |
| 325006000 | Of course. I understand. | 啊，也对。 |
| 325006010 | Why place trust in a perfect stranger? | 对素昧平生的人，要有所防备嘛。 |
| 325006020 | Be safe, then, stranger. | 那么，和你说声再会。 |
| 325006030 | Watch you don't get sacrificed, eh. I'll do the same. | 希望彼此都能平安，不会沦为祭品。 |
| 325007000 | Oh? Something bothering you? | 哦？还有什么事吗？ |
| 325007010 | Or are you just trying to pass the time? | 难道说……你改变心意，愿意告诉我了？ |
| 325007020 | I'm curious how you ended up inside this castle. | 你是为什么来到这座城呢？ |
| 325020000 | Ah, we meet again after all. | ……嗨，你好，又见面了。 |
| 325020010 | I apologise for any offence given by my bearing, but I'm quite unable to move, you see. | 抱歉，用这种姿势跟你说话，\n但我的身体真的无法动弹。 |
| 325020020 | So. What do you need? | 所以找我有什么事吗？ |

| 326009000 | Well, until we meet again. | ……再会了。 |
| 326010000 | You... | ……是你…… |
| 326010010 | What in heaven's name are you doing here? | 为什么来这种地方？ |
| 326010020 | The Volcano Manor is a pit of recusants who spit at grace and hunt our own kind. | 火山官邸是亵渎赐福、\n狩猎同胞的叛律者聚集的巢穴。 |
| 326010030 | I hope you understand the weight of my words. | 你懂这代表什么吗？ |
| 326011000 | Well. As long as you understand what you're saying. | ……明白的话，我不多说。 |
| 326011010 | I thought you a Tarnished bred by virtue. | 我还以为你是褪色者中的楷模…… |
| 326011020 | Perhaps playing that part led you to your doubts, I wonder. | 也可能正因为如此，才会感到疑惑。 |
| 326011030 | But know that the path you walk is blasphemy, and leads only to a miserable death. | 参与亵渎，最后只会不得善终， |
| 326011040 | Before you consider hunting any of your own kind, think on that. | 劝你狩猎同胞之前，先仔细思考。 |
| 326012000 | This blasphemous path leads only to a pitiful death. | 参与亵渎，最后只会不得善终， |
| 326012010 | Before you consider hunting any of your own kind, think on that. | 劝你狩猎同胞之前，先仔细思考。 |
| 326013000 | So. You've bloodied your sword in the hunt. | ……你狩猎同胞了。 |
| 326013010 | Then I shall introduce myself once more. | 那是该重新介绍自己── |
| 326013020 | Bernahl, a recusant, just like you. | 我是贝纳尔，和你一样是叛律者。 |
| 326013030 | Recusants have particular battle arts, styled to our methods of slaughter. | ……而叛律者自然有叛律者的战法，\n也就是所谓的战技。 |
| 326013040 | Why not add some to your repertoire? | 学了是有备无患。 |
| 326014000 | Oh, not had your fill, eh? | ……哦，还学得不够吗？ |
| 326015000 | You're still alive, I see. | ……你还活着啊。 |
| 326015010 | Why not learn another battle art, see if we can't keep it that way. | 那再来学习战技吧。 |
| 326016000 | You've come to understand, now, eh? | ……我想你也很明了。 |
| 326016010 | To take power and make it his own, | 抢夺他人的力量、化为己有── |
| 326016020 | The recusant must hunt his own kind. | 就是叛律者狩猎同胞的目的。 |
| 326016030 | To raise the flag of revolt against this sanctified pillaging, | 为了那被迫互相残杀的恶令，叛律者揭竿而起。 |
| 326016040 | We recusants must become the most wretched of predators. | 但到头来，却变成最为肤浅的掠食者。 |
| 326016050 | All you can do is laugh. | ……真可笑。 |
| 326017000 | Look at you. A recusant through and through. | ……你越来越有叛律者的味道了。 |
| 326017010 | I knew you had it in you. | 正所谓适才适所吧。 |
| 326017020 | Take this. | 这个交给你。 |
| 326017030 | A special invitation, to hunt some of the first Tarnished who sat at the Roundtable Hold. | 那是特殊的邀请函──\n邀请你狩猎圆桌厅堂的创始褪色者，其中的幸存者。 |
| 326017040 | If you should accept, I'll next see you on the field of battle. | 有意思出席的话，届时在战场会合吧。 |
| 326018000 | Ah, I had hoped you'd soon return. | 我等你很久了。 |
| 326018010 | I have the reward from Lady Tanith. | 塔妮丝女士拿给我先前那场狩猎的谢礼。 |
| 326018020 | Take it. It's yours, by right. | 但这谢礼该由你收下。 |
| 326018030 | Let us tread the path of the recusant together. | ……一起在叛律的路上前进吧， |
| 326018040 | Till we reach the miserable death that awaits us. | 直到不得善终的时刻到来。 |
| 326020000 | So. You killed Rykard? | ……看来你杀害了拉卡德。 |
| 326020010 | I harbour you no ill will. The strong take. Such is our code. | 我无意出言责备，\n弱肉强食是我们的规矩。 |
| 326020020 | Even he was prepared to meet a wretched end when he first took blasphemy unto his very flesh. | 在投身亵渎之中的那一刻起，\n他应该也做好不得善终的心理准备。 |
| 326020030 | But anyroad, the Volcano Manor is no more. | ……但这样一来，火山官邸也就此落幕。 |
| 326020040 | Though we may yet fulfil an old promise. | 我该履行以前许下的约定了。 |
| 326020050 | We hunted our own kind, and took what was theirs. | ……我狩猎了不少同胞，也抢夺了不少力量。 |
| 326020060 | And with everything in hand, the time has come to rise, against the Erdtree. | 这一切都是为了对黄金树举剑相向，\n时机已经成熟。 |
| 326021000 | O Greater Will, hear my voice. | ……无上意志啊，仔细听好。 |
| 326021010 | I am the recusant Bernahl, inheritor of my brother's will, and you will fall to my blade. | 我“叛律者”贝纳尔继承了挚友的遗志，\n决意要让你溃不成形。 |
| 326021020 | We refuse to become your pawns. Consider this fair warning. | 我们不会沦为你手掌心的傀儡，\n你很快就能亲身领教。 |
| 326030000 | Who are you? | ……你…… |
| 326030010 | And what in heaven's name are you doing here? | 为什么来这种地方？ |
| 326030020 | The Volcano Manor is a pit of recusants who spit at grace and hunt our own kind. | 火山官邸是亵渎赐福、\n狩猎同胞的叛律者聚集的巢穴。 |
| 326030030 | I hope you understand the weight of my words. | 你懂这代表什么吗？ |
| 326040000 | Well. As long as you understand what you're saying. | ……明白的话，我不多说。 |
| 326040010 | You have harboured doubts from the very beginning. | 原本你就心存迷惘， |
| 326040020 | Perhaps this day was always lurking on the horizon. | 会走到这一步也是必然吧。 |
| 326040030 | But know that the path you walk is blasphemy, and leads only to a miserable death. | 但参与亵渎，最后只会不得善终， |
| 326040040 | Before you consider hunting any of your own kind, think on that. | 劝你狩猎同胞之前，先仔细思考。 |
| 326041000 | Then you must leave immediately. | ……那就立刻离开。 |
| 326041010 | Those with weak stomachs have no place here. | 没有决心叛律的家伙，只会碍手碍脚。 |
| 326042000 | I thought I told you to leave. | ……我说了立刻离开吧？ |
| 326042010 | Or do you claim to understand? | ……还是你真的明白？ |
| 326042020 | What it means to be a recusant, renouncing grace and hunting down one's own. | 成为亵渎赐福、狩猎同胞的叛律者，代表着什么？ |
| 326043000 | Well. As long as you understand what you're saying. | ……明白的话，我不多说。 |
| 326043010 | But know that the path you walk is blasphemy, and leads only to a miserable death. | 参与亵渎，最后只会不得善终， |
| 326043020 | Before you consider hunting any of your own kind, think on that. | 劝你狩猎同胞之前，先仔细思考。 |
| 326100000 | Oh, a brew, is it? | ……哦，是酒啊。 |
| 326100010 | Thanking me for the battle arts? | 这是传承战技给你的谢礼吗？ |
| 326100020 | You're one of the good ones. Thank you. | 礼数真周到，那我不客气了。 |
| 326101000 | Oh, a brew, is it? | ……哦，是酒啊。 |
| 326101010 | Fitting, I suppose. | ……确实，对沉醉于亵渎的叛律者来说， |
| 326101020 | For a recusant already drunk on blasphemy. | 酒说不定是很适合的礼物。 |
| 326102000 | <sleeping> | …… |
| 326800000 | Agh! | 唔。 |
| 326800010 | What's wrong with you? | 你这是做什么？ |
| 326800020 | I won't say it twice. Stop this. | 好话不说第二遍，住手吧。 |
| 326801000 | I suppose I have no choice, then. | ……不得不战吗？ |
| 326801010 | Is this what grace would have of us? | 赐福啊，这也是指引吗？ |
| 326802000 | Dog eat dog, once again. A sad lot, we Tarnished. | 又是互相残杀的肤浅作为，\n这就是我们褪色者…… |
| 326803000 | You are an enigma, to be certain. | ……你这人有意思…… |
| 326803010 | The Volcano Manor awaits you. | 去火山官邸吧…… |
| 330001000 | You're Tarnished, aren't you? | ……阁下是褪色者吗？ |
| 330001010 | I welcome you, to the Church of Vows. | 欢迎来到结缘教堂。 |
| 330001020 | I am Miriel, steward of this sacred chamber. | 我名叫米利耶，负责管理这座教堂。 |
| 330001030 | My apologies, for the unseemly state of affairs. | 只是任它荒废成这副模样，着实令人汗颜…… |
| 330001040 | Do you know the origin of this place? | 在这里，想请教阁下是否听过？ |
| 330001050 | How it came to be known as the Church of Vows? | 关于这座结缘教堂，背后有什么样的故事。 |
| 330002000 | Well, that is a shame. But who can blame you? | 啊，阁下不清楚啊。这也是很自然的事情。 |
| 330002010 | The Shattering has caused us - all of us - to lose sight of something very dear. | 毕竟在爆发破碎战争之后，\n人们都遗忘了那些重要的事情。 |
| 330002020 | It is here, at the Church of Vows, that the great houses of the Erdtree and the Moon were joined. | 过去黄金树与月，双方王室为求和平共存── |
| 330002030 | By the matrimonial bond between red-haired Radagon and Rennala of the Full Moon. | “红发”拉达冈与“满月”蕾娜菈，\n两位大人就是在这座教堂缔结契约。 |
| 330002040 | And so, our church holds in view the monuments of both houses. | 至今这座教堂与王城黄金树，\n以及雷亚卢卡利亚学院仍有所联系， |
| 330002050 | The Erdtree of the Capital, and the Academy of Raya Lucaria. | 也是出自这个原因。 |
| 330003000 | Oh, was there something you needed? | 啊，这么说来，阁下有什么事吗？ |
| 330003010 | You are free to show yourself around. | 如果阁下的目的是参观，就请随意。 |
| 330003020 | I would serve as your guide, only my legs aren't what they used to be... | 我的脚已经不方便行走，\n没办法领着阁下四处介绍…… |
| 330003030 | If you find anything of use, you are free to take it with you. | 如果看到需要的物品，不必介意，带走它吧。 |
| 330003040 | Unless perhaps you are in search of instruction? | 还是说，阁下是为了学问而来呢？ |
| 330003050 | In which case, I will share all that I know. | 真是如此，我愿意倾囊相授。 |
| 330003060 | Whether it be sorcery or incantations, learning should not fetter you to one side or the other. | 魔法也好，祷告也罢──学问不分高低。 |
| 330003070 | This is, after all, a church celebrating the union of two such opposed practitioners. | 在两者结合的地方，这道理更是自然。 |
| 330004000 | Is there something else? | ……怎么了？还有什么事吗？ |
| 330010000 | Greetings. Do you need anything? | ……您好啊，有什么事呢？ |
| 330011000 | Do you possess any celestial dew? | ……阁下持有星星泪滴吗？ |
| 330011010 | Then I would like to share my knowledge with you. | 既然如此，那我需要告诉阁下── |
| 330011020 | Concerning the miracle of this Church of Vows. | 关于这座结缘教堂所蕴藏的奇迹。 |
| 330011030 | Radagon once cleansed himself with celestial dew, | 在过去，拉达冈大人用星星泪滴沐浴自身， |
| 330011040 | repented his territorial aggressions, and swore his love to Rennala. | 此举是为侵略战争真心忏悔，\n同时也是立誓，对蕾娜菈大人的爱永志不渝。 |
| 330011050 | The Order of the Erdtree and the fate of the moon were conjoined, and all the wounds of war forgiven. | 在黄金树律法与月之命运结合之际，\n所有的一切，包含纷争带来的伤害，就回归于零。 |
| 330011060 | This miracle blesses the church to this day. | 之后，那奇迹就一直留存在这座教堂里。 |
| 330011070 | And so, you need only follow Radagon's example, | 只要拉达冈大人做过的，阁下照着做── |
| 330011080 | to restore any bond, however strained or severed, to its rightful state of harmony. | 那产生裂痕、难以修复的人际关系，\n想必也能重回安稳的状态吧。 |
| 330012000 | My faith does not waver. | ……我坚信不移── |
| 330012010 | The miracle rooted in these grounds will, once again, mend the world. | 总有一天，蕴藏在这块土地的奇迹，\n能够再一次将世界连系起来。 |
| 330012020 | And this time, its bounty will not be squandered. | 而且这一次，毁约之事不会再发生。 |
| 330012030 | If you would be Elden Lord, Tarnished, | 褪色者啊，如果阁下当上了艾尔登之王， |
| 330012040 | I hope that you, too, will share my faith. | 请成为有如此作为的王者吧。 |
| 330014000 | Are you taking the sword with you? | ……阁下想带走那把剑吗？ |
| 330014010 | Oh, fear not, I don't wish to chide you. | 啊，不是，我没有责问的意思。 |
| 330014020 | Clearly, you are no conniving thief. | 阁下不可能是可鄙的梁上君子， |
| 330014030 | The sword is telling us something, no doubt. | 既然如此，那肯定是剑本身想离开此处。 |
| 330014040 | Rather than collect dust in the shadows underground, | 与其被供奉在无人出入的地下室， |
| 330014050 | it yearns to be wielded by your rightful hand. | 那把剑更希望阁下正确地使用它。 |
| 330014060 | Ah, now I recall. | ……相信肯定是如此。 |
| 330014070 | As the priest of the Church of Vows, I undo the sword's seal, and bequeath it unto you. | 我身为结缘教堂的神父，\n愿意解除剑的封印，把它交给阁下。 |
| 330014080 | May you hold it high and proud. | 请大方地挥舞那把剑吧。 |
| 330020000 | Are you quite finished? | ……您冷静下来了吗？ |
| 330020010 | Take this opportunity to learn to master your emotions. | 请趁这次机会，学会控制自己的情绪。 |
| 330020020 | Worry not, I take no offence. But others are not always so forgiving. | 我倒是无妨，但相同情况发生在其他人身上， |
| 330020030 | Some take to anger, others sorrow... Bonds are fragile things, wont to break under strain. | 有些人会生气，有些人会难过……\n人际关系会产生裂痕，或是陷入难以修复的境地。 |
| 330020040 | And once they're broken, everything is lost, with naught to gain. | 这对阁下而言，绝对是有害无益。 |
| 330021000 | Are you quite finished? | ……您冷静下来了吗？ |
| 330021010 | I suppose my ample frame must have given you quite the fright. | 看到身形巨大的生物，想必让阁下吓了一跳。 |
| 330021020 | Allow me to introduce myself. Miriel, steward of this sacred chamber. | 请容我自我介绍──\n我名叫米利耶，负责管理这座教堂。 |
| 330021030 | My apologies, for the unseemly state of affairs. | 只是任它荒废成这副模样，着实令人汗颜…… |
| 330021040 | Do you know the origin of this place? | 在这里，想请教阁下是否听过？ |
| 330021050 | How it came to be known as the Church of Vows? | 关于这座结缘教堂，背后有什么样的故事。 |
| 330022000 | Are you quite finished, now? | ……您冷静下来了吗？ |
| 330031000 | To experience the miracle, kneel in the basin at the back, and cleanse yourself with celestial dew. | ……如果阁下期盼奇迹发生，\n请到里头的水池中跪下，用星星泪滴沐浴自身。 |
| 330031010 | Absolution will be yours. Any bond, no matter how strained, or even severed, will be put to rights. | 此举为赎罪──那产生裂痕、难以修复的人际关系，\n想必也能重回安稳的状态吧。 |
| 330033000 | Ah, I see you have undergone absolution, the miracle that blossoms from these grounds. | ……我注意到阁下蒙受这块土地的奇迹，完成了赎罪。 |
| 330033010 | Good. As such, the bond you may have strained or severed... | 没错。如此一来，阁下那产生裂痕、难以修复的人际关系， |
| 330033020 | Has been restored, to its rightful state of harmony. | 想必已经重回安稳的状态。 |
| 330033030 | Be mindful, not to take for granted... | ……奇迹带来的安稳时光， |
| 330033040 | the serenity restored by this miracle. | 请阁下好好珍惜。 |
| 330033050 | And take care. Never to break a bond again. | 并请多留意，别让憾事再次发生。 |
| 330050000 | You wish to know more of Lord Radagon? | ……您想知道关于拉达冈大人的事情啊。 |
| 330050010 | Lord Radagon was a great champion, possessed of flowing red locks. | 拉达冈大人是有着一头飘逸红发的英雄。 |
| 330050020 | He came to these lands at the head of a great golden host, when he met Lady Rennala in battle. | 他率领黄金树的军队来到此地，\n在战场上邂逅了蕾娜菈大人。 |
| 330050030 | He soon repented his territorial aggressions though, and became husband to the Carian Queen. | 随后对发起侵略战争一事真心忏悔，\n和卡利亚女王，蕾娜菈大人结为伴侣。 |
| 330050040 | However. When Godfrey, first Elden Lord, was hounded from the Lands Between, | ……但是在初始艾尔登之王，葛孚雷被逐出交界地之后， |
| 330050050 | Radagon left Rennala to return to the Erdtree Capital, becoming Queen Marika's second husband and King Consort. | 拉达冈大人抛弃了蕾娜菈大人，回到黄金树王城，\n成为玛莉卡女王的王夫、第二任丈夫…… |
| 330050060 | Taking the title...of second Elden Lord. | 也成为第二任的艾尔登之王。 |
| 330050070 | The mystery endures, to this day... | 这件事情依旧成谜── |
| 330050080 | As to why Lord Radagon would cast Lady Rennala aside... | 为了什么原因，拉达冈大人抛弃蕾娜菈大人？ |
| 330050090 | And moreover...why a mere champion would be chosen for the seat of Elden Lord... | 又话说从头，拉达冈大人不过是位英雄，\n为什么会被选为艾尔登之王呢？ |
| 330051000 | You know, it's said that Lord Radagon harboured a secret... | ……不过，关于拉达冈大人……\n我曾听说一个关于他的秘密。 |
| 330051010 | A famed sculptor of the Erdtree Capital was once summoned to render Lord Radagon's likeness in giant stature. | 黄金树王城里有一位知名的雕刻家，\n受王室委托，制作拉达冈大人的大型雕像…… |
| 330051020 | When he glimpsed the skeleton in Radagon's closet. | 听说他因此窥见了那个秘密。 |
| 330051030 | And as such, it's said the great statue harbours his secret too. | 又听说，那座大型雕像藏着那个秘密。 |
| 330052000 | You wish to know more of Lady Rennala? | ……您想知道关于蕾娜菈大人的事情啊。 |
| 330052010 | She is Queen, head of the Carian royal family, and governor of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. | 蕾娜菈大人是卡利亚王室的女王，\n也是雷亚卢卡利亚学院的掌权者。 |
| 330052020 | The great and beautiful Full Moon Witch. | 一名既伟大又美丽的“满月”魔法师。 |
| 330052030 | Sadly, her heart was broken when Lord Radagon left her. | 但是啊，自从丈夫拉达冈大人抛弃了她，\n她就失去了自己的心。 |
| 330052040 | And then, when the academy rebelled against the royals, she was locked away in the grand library. | 在学院背叛王室的时候，她被囚禁在大书库里头。 |
| 330053000 | In the end, Lady Rennala was left alone, cradling the amber egg Lord Radagon bequeathed her. | ……事情发生之后，蕾娜菈大人仰赖着\n拉达冈大人赠予的琥珀卵，度过每一日。 |
| 330053010 | Now she devotes herself to it through forbidden rite; | 将自己的一切奉献在不容于世的法术上── |
| 330053020 | the grim art of reincarnation. | 那恐怖无比的，重新诞生的秘术。 |
| 330053030 | You would do well to remember... | ……希望阁下能记得， |
| 330053040 | Severing a vow, strongest of bonds, has consequences ever more dire. | 在结下缘分之后遭到反悔，\n所带来的伤害是难以估计啊。 |
| 330060000 | Why, this is nectar, is it not? | ……哦，这是……是甘露啊。 |
| 330060010 | And you're giving it to me? | 阁下要送给我吗？ |
| 330060020 | Oh, wonderful, just wonderful. | 哦哦，真令人喜上眉梢。 |
| 330060030 | Truth be told, I'm rather fond of the stuff. | 老实说，我非常喜爱甘露。 |
| 330060040 | I'll happily take it off your hands! | 恕我不推辞了。 |
| 330061000 | <sleeping> | …… |
| 330100000 | Oh, what have we here? | ……哦，这确实不错。 |
| 330100010 | Very well, let us both learn together. | 让我们一同学习，教学相长吧。 |
| 330100020 | Heresy is not native to the world; it is but a contrivance. | ……这个世界原本没有异端， |
| 330100030 | All things can be conjoined. | 所有的一切都能结合、互融。 |

| 348062000 | There is something I must return to Malenia. | ……我想要还给玛莲妮亚── |

| 349001000 | Oh, a pleasure to see you, a pleasure indeed. | ……哦哦，恭候多时了。 |
| 349001010 | I am Gowry. A great sage, in my day, anyway. | 我名叫格威。\n在过去，人们称我为贤者。 |

| 349001050 | Should you accept… | 只要您答应我的请求…… |

| 349010010 | I need your help to heal a certain young girl. | 老实说，我需要您帮忙治疗一个女孩。 |
| 349010020 | Her name is Millicent. You will find her beyond Sellia, | 那女孩名叫米莉森，\n她人在穿过那座瑟利亚镇之后， |
| 349010030 | resting at the church atop the cliff, stricken by the rotting sickness. | 一座山崖上的教堂里。\n罹患了腐败病，在那卧病不起。 |

| 349014020 | I'll gladly share with you the secret of Sellia, the town yonder. | 我愿意告诉您──\n那边那座瑟利亚镇，到底隐藏了什么秘密。 |

| 349021050 | Tended to by the witless pests who worship her, or rather, her rotting sickness, as a god. | 一群无知的坏虫殷勤呵护她，把她……\n不对，把她的腐败病当作神在奉养。 |
| 349021060 | A wretched fate, indeed. The poor girl, she never wished for any of this. | 您不认为这件事太过荒唐吗？\n那女孩毫无理由受这种对待。 |

| 349030010 | For giving the needle to Millicent. | 您把针交到米莉森手中了吧？ |

| 349051050 | Since Malenia fought Radahn, and the great scarlet flower blossomed in Aeonia, I have dedicated myself to her. | 从玛莲妮亚大人与拉塔恩战斗，在艾奥尼亚\n让猩红大花怒放那一天起，我的心就成了俘虏── |
| 349051060 | And to the resplendence of the Order of Rot. The cycle of decay and rebirth. | 我心系着玛莲妮亚大人、灿烂夺目的腐败律法。\n也就是那盛极转衰的轮回法则…… |
| 349060000 | Oh, Millicent. Finding herself, is she? | ……哦，原来。那女孩这么说了…… |

| 349070000 | <sobbing> | ……呜呜、呜呜呜…… |

| 801200010 | Oh, dear, terribly sorry. | ……啊，不、不好意思…… |
| 801200020 | Are you here as a customer? | 您是客人吗……？ |
| 801201000 | Oh... | 请、请问…… |
| 801201010 | Is there anything wrong? | 我有哪里不周到吗……？ |
| 801202000 | Ooh! | 噫噫！ |
| 801202010 | Ah, oh, terribly sorry... | ……啊，不、不好意思…… |
| 801202020 | I-I didn't realise you came back. | 您再度莅临了啊。 |
| 801203000 | I-I must apologise. | 万分抱、抱歉…… |
| 801203010 | I'm afraid I've very little to offer. | 商品不是很尽善尽美…… |
| 801204000 | Oh, nothing that suits your tastes, then? | 您、您不满意吗？ |
| 801204010 | Heh heh... | 呵、呵呵…… |
| 801250000 | What do you need? | ……你是客人吗？ |
| 801250010 | I don't want any trouble. | ……别做出节外生枝的举动。 |
| 801251000 | You again? | ……又来了？ |
| 801251010 | I don't want any trouble. | ……别做出节外生枝的举动。 |
| 801252000 | All done? | ……好了？ |
| 801252010 | Well, be on your way, then. | 那就快点离开。 |
| 801300000 | Well… | ……哦…… |
| 801300010 | It's been an age since I've seen a customer. | 已经很久没有客人上门了。 |
| 801300020 | How can I help, here at the end of the earth? | ……你跑到这么偏僻的地方，求的是什么？ |
| 801301000 | Anything else for you? | ……又想买些什么吗？ |
| 801302000 | Back already? | ……你又来啦。 |
| 801302010 | Unusual fellow, aren't we. | 说来你还真是奇特。 |
| 801302020 | Did this aged merchant have something that caught your eye? | 这些老商人的货物，有什么吸引到你的目光吗？ |
| 801303000 | Have a safe journey. | ……保重啊。 |
| 801350000 | Is someone there? | ……有人在那里吗？ |
| 801350010 | A customer? | ……想做买卖？ |
| 801350020 | Well, how long has it been. | 这件事，久远到令人怀念啊。 |
| 801351000 | Something else? | ……还想做买卖吗？ |
| 801352000 | Well, there you are again. | ……哦，你又来了。 |
| 801352010 | Divorce from one's trade does not come easily. | 世袭职业真像影子，分也分不开啊。 |
| 801800000 | Agh! | 噫。 |
| 801800010 | Please! Stop this, good customer! | 不要！不要打，客人！ |
| 801801000 | Bollocks! What the devil's wrong with you! | 畜生！你有什么问题？ |
| 801802000 | Dirty little thief... | ……你这下贱的强盗。 |
| 801803000 | You dirty little thief... | ……下贱的强盗…… |
| 801803010 | Melt away with the rest of it... | ……燃烧吧、熔化吧…… |
| 801810000 | Owgh! | 唔。 |
| 801810010 | What are you playing at! Stop this! | 你干什么！住手！ |
| 801811000 | That's the last straw, you bloody thief! | 混账，少瞧不起人了，你这强盗！ |
| 801812000 | Stay away, Us wanderers have had enough. | ……别对我们流浪民族动手。 |
| 801813000 | How dare you trample us. | ……别以为事情就这样结束…… |
| 801813010 | You filthy thief. | ……你这强盗…… |
| 801820000 | A-agh! | 噫。 |
| 801820010 | S...stop | 不、要…… |
| 801820020 | P...please, s...stop | 客、人啊……住、手…… |
| 801821000 | E...enough | 够、了…… |
| 801821010 | M...melt away... | 熔化、吧…… |
| 801822000 | G-good...bye... | 永别、了…… |
| 801822010 | Dear...customer... | 客、人啊…… |
| 801823000 | But, why...? | 为什、么……？ |
| 801823010 | Kind...sir... | 客、人啊…… |
| 801823011 | Madame... | 客、人啊…… |
| 801824000 | You've always... | ……客、人啊…… |
| 801824010 | been...too kind... | 常来、谢谢…… |
| 801830000 | Ngh! | 唔。 |
| 801830010 | Enough. | 住手。 |
| 801831000 | Another thief? Fine. | ……遇上强盗啊，那没办法。 |
| 801832000 | What folly. | ……无聊。 |
| 801833000 | How in the... | ……什么…… |
| 801833010 | Blast... | 怎么可能…… |
| 801840000 | Eh! | 噫。 |
| 801840010 | Please! | 噫噫！快住手！ |
| 801840020 | Please, stop this! | 请您快住手！ |
| 801840030 | It was me! It's all my fault! | 我道歉！我会道歉！ |
| 801840040 | Please, don't hurt me! | 请不要这样对我！ |
| 801841000 | I said don't hurt me! | 我不是说住手了吗！ |
| 801841010 | Aaargh! | 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！ |
| 801842000 | I warned you. I told you to stop... | ……所以我才说，要你住手啊…… |
| 801843000 | How could you... | ……好过分…… |
| 801843010 | What have I ever done? | 我有做了什么吗……？ |
| 801843020 | Heh heh... | 呵、呵呵…… |
| 801850000 | Ow! | 噫。 |
| 801851000 | I knew it, you dirty scoundrel! | 你果然非善类！ |
| 801851010 | There was something off about you from the start! | 打从一开始我就觉得可疑！ |
| 801852000 | Hurry up and die! You wretched thief! | 去死吧！臭强盗！ |
| 801853000 | Rotten scoundrels... | ……真的是…… |
| 801853010 | Every last one of 'em... | 没有人信得过…… |
| 801860000 | Agh! | 呜。 |
| 801861000 | Enough of that. | ……别再动手了。 |
| 801861010 | Surely you are no highwayman. | 除非你是夺人财物的盗匪。 |
| 801862000 | A pity, this. | ……太可悲了。 |
| 801862010 | Our descent into savagery. | 最近只碰见这种人物。 |
| 801863000 | You've never heard? | 难道没有人提醒过你， |
| 801863010 | Of the swiftness of a wanderer's fury. | 流浪民族到底有多恐怖？ |
| 801864000 | Offed by a highwayman? | 竟然会败给盗匪…… |
| 801864010 | I must've lost my touch… | 岁月不饶人啊…… |
| 801870000 | Agh! | 呜。 |
| 801871000 | Stop this at once. | ……停下来。 |
| 801871010 | And I will forgive you. | 现在停手，我能不追究。 |
| 801872000 | You'd come this far for your pillaging? | ……在这种地方也会遇上强盗。 |
| 801872010 | No different than a plague, your kind. | 你们真的是无所不在。 |
| 801873000 | I've heard enough from you. Be gone. | 真烦人，消失吧。 |
| 801874000 | All that I wanted was solitude… | ……就连唯一的孤独，也不能拥有吗……？ |

| 21020000 | Lord brother. | 哥哥。 |
| 21020100 | I'm going to be a god. | 我一定会成为神祇。 |

| 21020300 | promise me you'll be my consort. | 请你成为我的王。 |
| 21020400 | I'll make the world a gentler place. | ……我想打造一个温柔的世界。 |
| 21030000 | O Horn-deck'd beast, from higher sphere deliver'd. | 噢，角之兽啊，神兽啊── |
| 21030050 | O Horn-deck'd beast, from higher sphere deliver'd. | ……噢，角之兽啊，神兽啊…… |
| 21030100 | Take root inside the tower's sculpted keepers. | 栖宿于塔之子，勇人们的体内， |
| 21030150 | We beg of thee to dance and cavort. | ……为了我等、舞动吧…… |
| 21030200 | And perch'd within, we beg of thee; rise. | 为了我等舞动吧。 |
| 21030250 | And with the beauty of thy grand display... | ……舞得绚丽、舞得华美…… |
| 21030300 | Dance and cavort, cleanse all that thou wilt. | 舞得绚丽、舞得华美，净化一切吧── |
| 21030350 | Cleanse away the foulness fate imposed. | ……净化、厄运吧…… |

| 21030500 | Cleanse away the strumpet's vile progeny. | 净化那群恶妇之子！ |
| 21040000 | I am Radahn. | ……我是、拉塔恩── |

| 21040200 | A lion bred for battle. | ……是狮子……也是战士。 |
| 21041000 | My loyal blade. And champion of the festival. | 我的锋刃，以及祭典的英雄啊。 |
| 21041100 | Both your deeds will ever be praised in song. | 你们奋战的轨迹，将被永世传唱。 |
| 21041200 | Now, the vow will be honoured, and my Lord brother's soul will return. | 如今约定履行，强大灵魂即将归来── |
| 21041300 | So that he may be my consort. | 成为我的王。 |
| 21050000 | I hereby swear. | 我在此宣誓： |
| 21050050 | Lord brother. | ……哥哥。 |
| 21050100 | To every living being, and every living soul. | 所有的生命，所有的灵魂啊， |
| 21050150 | At long last, you are returned. | 你终于回来了。 |
| 21050200 | Now comes the age of our eden. | 接下来即将迈入乐园时代── |
| 21050300 | A thousand year voyage guided by compassion. | 将遵循温柔的法则，开始千年的旅程。 |
| 21050350 | Tarnished one. | ……褪色者啊。 |
| 21050400 | Beginning here, love encompasses all. | 众生啊，唯独思考爱吧── |
| 21050450 | Aspiring Lord of the old order. | 老旧律法之王啊。 |
| 21050500 | No living thing will be denied, no deed censured. | 那不因人、不因事排拒，也不问罪过的存在。 |
| 21050550 | If you have known sin, if you grieve for this world, | 如果你对罪孽知情，并为世界烦忧── |
| 21050600 | I am ready. To embrace the whole of it. | 我将怀抱众生万物。 |
| 21050650 | then yield the path forward to us. | 就请你让出路来。 |
| 21050700 | Let us go together. | ……一起走吧。 |
| 21050750 | To I, Miquella, | 那条路由我米凯拉── |
| 21050800 | Radahn, my promised consort. | 拉塔恩──我约定的王啊。 |
| 21050850 | and my promised consort, Radahn. | 以及我约定的王，拉塔恩前行。 |
